scripts.code:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Clean up any old GUI or tools
if LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ToolMenuGui") then
    LocalPlayer.PlayerGui["ToolMenuGui"]:Destroy()
end
if LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PlayerSpyGui") then
    LocalPlayer.PlayerGui["PlayerSpyGui"]:Destroy()
end

for _, oldName in ipairs({"Spying Tool", "PlayerSpyTool"}) do
    if LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(oldName) then LocalPlayer.Backpack[oldName]:Destroy() end
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(oldName) then LocalPlayer.Character[oldName]:Destroy() end
end

---------------------------------------------------------
-- UNIFIED GUI MENU (Fixed Toolbar at Top-Right)
---------------------------------------------------------
local menuGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
menuGui.Name = "ToolMenuGui"
menuGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
menuGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
menuGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local menuFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
menuFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 390, 0, 45)
menuFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 310, 0, 5)
menuFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
menuFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
menuFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
menuFrame.Active = true
menuFrame.Parent = menuGui

local tool1Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
tool1Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 175, 0, 35)
tool1Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
tool1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
tool1Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
tool1Btn.TextSize = 12
tool1Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
tool1Btn.Text = "Spying Tool: OFF"
tool1Btn.Parent = menuFrame

local tool2Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
tool2Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 175, 0, 35)
tool2Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 5)
tool2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
tool2Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
tool2Btn.TextSize = 12
tool2Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
tool2Btn.Text = "PlayerSpy Tool: OFF"
tool2Btn.Parent = menuFrame


---------------------------------------------------------
-- TOOL 1: SPYING TOOL LOGIC (Blue Visor / Left Side)
---------------------------------------------------------
local model1 = Instance.new("Model")
model1.Name = "VRHeadsetGear1"

local handle1 = Instance.new("Part")
handle1.Name = "Handle"
handle1.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.5, 0.8)
handle1.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
handle1.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
handle1.CanCollide = false
handle1.Parent = model1

local visor1 = Instance.new("Part")
visor1.Name = "Visor"
visor1.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 0.35, 0.2)
visor1.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan") -- Blue/Cyan Visor
visor1.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
visor1.CFrame = handle1.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.4)
visor1.CanCollide = false
visor1.Parent = model1

local weld1 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
weld1.Part0 = handle1
weld1.Part1 = visor1
weld1.Parent = handle1
model1.PrimaryPart = handle1

local modifiedParts = {}
local isSpyActive = false
local addedConnection = nil
local renderConnection = nil
local weldToHead1 = nil
local oldBrightness, oldClockTime, oldGlobalShadows, oldOutdoorAmbient, oldAmbient, oldFogEnd

local function isPlayerPart(obj)
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function applyTransparency(obj)
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(model1) and not isPlayerPart(obj) then
        if not modifiedParts[obj] then
            modifiedParts[obj] = { Transparency = obj.Transparency, SurfaceAppearances = {} }
            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("Decal") then
                    table.insert(modifiedParts[obj].SurfaceAppearances, child)
                    child.Parent = nil
                end
            end
        end
        obj.Transparency = 0.75
    end
end

local function enableSpy()
    isSpyActive = true
    tool1Btn.Text = "Spying Tool: ON"
    tool1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        model1.Parent = char
        handle1.Anchored = false
        handle1.CanCollide = false
        weldToHead1 = Instance.new("Weld")
        weldToHead1.Part0 = char.Head
        weldToHead1.Part1 = handle1
        weldToHead1.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.25, 0.2, -0.55) -- Positioned on the left side
        weldToHead1.Parent = handle1
    end

    oldBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
    oldClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
    oldGlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
    oldOutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
    oldAmbient = Lighting.Ambient
    oldFogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd

    renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if isSpyActive then
            Lighting.Brightness = 10
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if not isSpyActive then break end
            applyTransparency(obj)
        end
    end)

    addedConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if isSpyActive then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait()
                applyTransparency(obj)
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local function disableSpy()
    isSpyActive = false
    tool1Btn.Text = "Spying Tool: OFF"
    tool1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)

    if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect(); renderConnection = nil end
    if weldToHead1 then weldToHead1:Destroy(); weldToHead1 = nil end
    if addedConnection then addedConnection:Disconnect(); addedConnection = nil end
    model1.Parent = nil

    if oldBrightness then
        Lighting.Brightness = oldBrightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = oldClockTime
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = oldGlobalShadows
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = oldOutdoorAmbient
        Lighting.Ambient = oldAmbient
        Lighting.FogEnd = oldFogEnd
    end

    for obj, data in pairs(modifiedParts) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            obj.Transparency = data.Transparency
            for _, child in ipairs(data.SurfaceAppearances) do child.Parent = obj end
        end
    end
    modifiedParts = {}
end

tool1Btn.Activated:Connect(function()
    if isSpyActive then
        disableSpy()
    else
        enableSpy()
    end
end)


---------------------------------------------------------
-- TOOL 2: PLAYERSPY TOOL LOGIC (Red Visor / Right Side + Draggable Big Box)
---------------------------------------------------------
local model2 = Instance.new("Model")
model2.Name = "VRHeadsetGear2"

local handle2 = Instance.new("Part")
handle2.Name = "Handle"
handle2.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.5, 0.8)
handle2.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
handle2.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
handle2.CanCollide = false
handle2.Parent = model2

local visor2 = Instance.new("Part")
visor2.Name = "Visor"
visor2.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 0.35, 0.2)
visor2.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red") -- Red Visor
visor2.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
visor2.CFrame = handle2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.4)
visor2.CanCollide = false
visor2.Parent = model2

local weld2 = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
weld2.Part0 = handle2
weld2.Part1 = visor2
weld2.Parent = handle2
model2.PrimaryPart = handle2

local isPlayerSpyActive = false
local weldToHead2 = nil
local playerSpyFrame = nil
local highlights = {}
local updateLoop = nil
local espRefreshThread = nil

local nakedPlayers = {}
local nakedAllEnabled = false
local storedClothing = {}

local function applyNaked(char, player)
    if not char then return end
    if not storedClothing[player] then
        storedClothing[player] = {}
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Clothing") or child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or child:IsA("BodyColors") then
                table.insert(storedClothing[player], child)
            end
        end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Clothing") or child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or child:IsA("BodyColors") then
            child.Parent = nil
        end
    end
end

local function restoreClothes(player)
    if storedClothing[player] and player.Character then
        for _, child in ipairs(storedClothing[player]) do
            if child and child.Parent == nil then
                child.Parent = player.Character
            end
        end
        storedClothing[player] = nil
    end
end

local function resetAllNakedStates()
    nakedAllEnabled = false
    for p, _ in pairs(nakedPlayers) do
        nakedPlayers[p] = false
        restoreClothes(p)
    end
    nakedPlayers = {}
end

local function parseCoords(str)
    if not str or type(str) ~= "string" then return nil end
    if str:match("[a-zA-Z]") or str:match("[%[%]{}#@!%$%%^&*()_+%%~`%%?<>%%/%%|%%\\]") then
        return nil
    end
    local matches = {}
    for num in str:gmatch("([%d%-%.]+)") do
        table.insert(matches, tonumber(num))
    end
    if #matches >= 3 then
        return Vector3.new(matches[1], matches[2], matches[3])
    end
    return nil
end

local function instantTP(targetCF)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local root = char.HumanoidRootPart
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        root.CFrame = targetCF
    end
end

local function enablePlayerSpy()
    isPlayerSpyActive = true
    tool2Btn.Text = "PlayerSpy Tool: ON"
    tool2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)

    -- Equip VR Headset on head (Right side)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
        model2.Parent = char
        handle2.Anchored = false
        handle2.CanCollide = false
        weldToHead2 = Instance.new("Weld")
        weldToHead2.Part0 = char.Head
        weldToHead2.Part1 = handle2
        weldToHead2.C0 = CFrame.new(0.25, 0.2, -0.55) -- Positioned on the right side
        weldToHead2.Parent = handle2
    end

    -- Independent Big Box GUI (Standalone and draggable anywhere)
    playerSpyFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    playerSpyFrame.Name = "PlayerSpyBox"
    playerSpyFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 390, 0, 325)
    playerSpyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 310, 0, 60)
    playerSpyFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    playerSpyFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
    playerSpyFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    playerSpyFrame.Active = true
    playerSpyFrame.Parent = menuGui

    -- Drag Handle Circle at the top center of the PlayerSpy big box GUI
    local dragCircle = Instance.new("TextButton")
    dragCircle.Name = "DragCircle"
    dragCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
    dragCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, -16)
    dragCircle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
    dragCircle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    dragCircle.TextSize = 14
    dragCircle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    dragCircle.Text = "⊙"
    dragCircle.ZIndex = 10
    dragCircle.Parent = playerSpyFrame

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    corner.Parent = dragCircle

    -- Dragging Logic for the Big Box GUI ONLY
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    dragCircle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = playerSpyFrame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    dragCircle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            playerSpyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)

    local topFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    topFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 105)
    topFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    topFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    topFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
    topFrame.ZIndex = 5
    topFrame.Parent = playerSpyFrame

    local coordBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    coordBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28)
    coordBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
    coordBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
    coordBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    coordBox.TextSize = 12
    coordBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    coordBox.PlaceholderText = "Type Coords (e.g. 10, 20, 30)"
    coordBox.Text = ""
    coordBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    coordBox.ZIndex = 6
    coordBox.Parent = topFrame

    local tpCoordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    tpCoordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 175, 0, 30)
    tpCoordBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
    tpCoordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    tpCoordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    tpCoordBtn.TextSize = 11
    tpCoordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    tpCoordBtn.Text = "Activate Coordinate TP"
    tpCoordBtn.ZIndex = 6
    tpCoordBtn.Parent = topFrame

    local nakedAllBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    nakedAllBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 175, 0, 30)
    nakedAllBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 40)
    nakedAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = nakedAllEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
    nakedAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    nakedAllBtn.TextSize = 11
    nakedAllBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    nakedAllBtn.Text = nakedAllEnabled and "Naked All: ON" or "Naked All: OFF"
    nakedAllBtn.ZIndex = 6
    nakedAllBtn.Parent = topFrame

    local container = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    container.Name = "Container"
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 215)
    container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 110)
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.ZIndex = 2
    container.Active = true
    container.Parent = playerSpyFrame

    local uiLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    uiLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    uiLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    uiLayout.Parent = container

    tpCoordBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        local pos = parseCoords(coordBox.Text)
        if pos then
            instantTP(CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
        else
            coordBox.Text = "Error wrong coordinate try (0 0 0) = (xyz)"
        end
    end)

    nakedAllBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        nakedAllEnabled = not nakedAllEnabled
        if nakedAllEnabled then
            nakedAllBtn.Text = "Naked All: ON"
            nakedAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                nakedPlayers[p] = true
            end
        else
            nakedAllBtn.Text = "Naked All: OFF"
            nakedAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 50, 150)
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                nakedPlayers[p] = false
                restoreClothes(p)
            end
        end
    end)

    espRefreshThread = task.spawn(function()
        while isPlayerSpyActive do
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player.Character then
                    local pChar = player.Character
                    
                    if nakedAllEnabled then
                        nakedPlayers[player] = true
                        applyNaked(pChar, player)
                    elseif nakedPlayers[player] then
                        applyNaked(pChar, player)
                    else
                        restoreClothes(player)
                    end

                    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                        if not highlights[player] or highlights[player].Parent ~= pChar then
                            if highlights[player] then highlights[player]:Destroy() end
                            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                            hl.Name = "PlayerSpyHighlight"
                            hl.Adornee = pChar
                            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            hl.FillTransparency = 0.3
                            hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                            hl.Parent = pChar
                            highlights[player] = hl
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local playerRows = {}

    updateLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not isPlayerSpyActive then return end

        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        for plr, row in pairs(playerRows) do

scripts.title: inventory gun esp
scripts.author: yercylol
scripts.summary: this script only focus on guns in Shinjuku 1988 it draws what gun is in other players inventory simple script open source.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().InvESP = {
    Enabled = true,
    TextSize = 13,
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)  
}

local ESP_Drawings = {}
local importantWeapons = {"nambu", "howa", "p9", "mp5", "mossberg", "fishing rod"}  

local function GetPlayerInventory(player)
    local items = {}
    if not player.Character then return items end

    
    for _, tool in ipairs(player.Character:GetChildren()) do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
            local nameLower = tool.Name:lower()
            for _, w in ipairs(importantWeapons) do
                if nameLower:find(w) then
                    table.insert(items, tool.Name)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

        local inventory = player:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
    if inventory then
        for _, slot in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
            if slot.Name:find("Slot") then
                for _, tool in ipairs(slot:GetChildren()) do
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                        local nameLower = tool.Name:lower()
                        for _, w in ipairs(importantWeapons) do
                            if nameLower:find(w) then
                                table.insert(items, tool.Name)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    
    local unique = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(items) do
        unique[v] = true
    end
    local final = {}
    for k in pairs(unique) do
        table.insert(final, k)
    end

    return final
end

local function RemoveESP(playerName)
    if ESP_Drawings[playerName] then
        ESP_Drawings[playerName]:Remove()
        ESP_Drawings[playerName] = nil
    end
end

local function UpdateInventoryESP()
    if not getgenv().InvESP.Enabled then
        for _, drawing in pairs(ESP_Drawings) do
            drawing.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer then continue end

        local character = player.Character
        if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            RemoveESP(player.Name)
            continue
        end

        local items = GetPlayerInventory(player)
        if #items == 0 then
            RemoveESP(player.Name)
            continue
        end

        local root = character.HumanoidRootPart
        local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))

        if not onScreen then
            RemoveESP(player.Name)
            continue
        end

        if not ESP_Drawings[player.Name] then
            local esp = Drawing.new("Text")
            esp.Color = getgenv().InvESP.Color
            esp.Outline = true
            esp.Center = true
            esp.Size = getgenv().InvESP.TextSize
            ESP_Drawings[player.Name] = esp
        end

        local esp = ESP_Drawings[player.Name]
        esp.Text = table.concat(items, "\n")
        esp.Position = Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y)
        esp.Visible = true
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(RemoveESP)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for playerName in pairs(ESP_Drawings) do
        local player = Players:FindFirstChild(playerName)
        if not player or not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            RemoveESP(playerName)
        end
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(UpdateInventoryESP)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F4 then
        getgenv().InvESP.Enabled = not getgenv().InvESP.Enabled
        print("Inventory ESP:", getgenv().InvESP.Enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
end)

print("Clean White Inventory ESP Loaded | Press F4 to toggle")

                if t:IsA("Tool") then
                    local n = t.Name:lower()
                    for _, k in ipairs(keys) do if n:find(k, 1, true) then return t end end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function teamKind(plr)
    local t = (plr.Team and plr.Team.Name:lower()) or ""
    if t:find("crim") then return "crim" end
    if t:find("guard") or t:find("police") or t:find("cop") then return "guard" end
    if t:find("inmate") or t:find("prison") then return "inmate" end
    return "other"
end

local function isEnemy(p)
    local mine, theirs = teamKind(lp), teamKind(p)
    if mine == "guard" then return theirs == "crim" end
    if mine == "crim" or mine == "inmate" then return theirs == "guard" end
    return true
end

local function nearestPlayer(filter, radius)
    local _, _, hrp = getChar()
    if not hrp then return end
    local best, bd
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp and (not filter or teamKind(p) == filter) then
            local t = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if t then
                local d = (t.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if (not radius or d < radius) and (not bd or d < bd) then best, bd = t, d end
            end
        end
    end

local function recoverHard()

    if not hrp then return end
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

        hum.Sit = false
        task.delay(0.15, function() pcall(function() hum.Sit = true end) end)

RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local _, hum, hrp = getChar()
    if not hrp or flags.fly or flags.carfly then return end
    if not flags.antifling then return end
    local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    if v.Magnitude > flags.flingCap then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v.Unit * flags.flingCap end
    if v.Magnitude > flags.flingCap * 2.5 then
        recoverHard(); doFlash()
        if flags.freeze then
            hrp.Anchored = true
            task.delay(0.22, function() if hrp and hrp.Parent then hrp.Anchored = false end end)
        end
    end
    if not lastSafe then lastSafe = hrp.CFrame end
    local dist = (hrp.Position - lastSafe.Position).Magnitude
    local now = os.clock()
    if dist > 120 and now - lastSafeTime > 2 then
        hrp.CFrame = lastSafe + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        lastSafeTime = now
    elseif dist < 22 then
        lastSafe = hrp.CFrame
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------ ANTI CAR-FLING V15
RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not flags.caraf or flags.carfly then acfPrevV = Vector3.zero; return end
    local _, hum, hrp = getChar()
    local seat = getSeat()
    if not seat or not hrp then acfPrevV = Vector3.zero; return end

    local root = seat.AssemblyRootPart or seat
    local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local deltaV = (v - acfPrevV).Magnitude
    acfPrevV = v
    local now = os.clock()

    local gap = (hrp.Position - seat.Position).Magnitude
    local impulse = deltaV > flags.acfImpulse
    local overspeed = v.Magnitude > flags.carCap
    local stretched = gap > 5

    if impulse or overspeed or stretched then
        acfHits += 1
        acfLast = now
    elseif now - acfLast > 2 then
        acfHits = 0
    end

    if acfHits == 0 then
        if v.Magnitude < flags.carCap * 0.8 then acfGood = seat.CFrame end
        return
    end

    -- tier 1: clamp
    if overspeed then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = v.Unit * flags.carCap end

    -- tier 2: anchor out the impulse
    if acfHits >= 2 and not root.Anchored then
        root.Anchored = true
        doFlash()
        task.delay(0.12, function() if root.Parent and not flags.caranchor then root.Anchored = false end end)
    end

    -- tier 3: break the weld
    if acfHits >= 4 and hum and hum.SeatPart then
        hum.Sit = false

    if acfGood and gap > 25 then

    end

    pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(lp) end)
end)

local function boneOf(chr)
    if flags.aimBone == "Head" then return chr:FindFirstChild("Head") end
    if flags.aimBone == "Torso" then return chr:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or chr:FindFirstChild("Torso") or chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    return chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function screenTarget(maxPx)
    local vp = camera.ViewportSize
    local ctr = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local best, bd
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp and isEnemy(p) then
            local chr = p.Character
            local hum = chr and chr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = chr and boneOf(chr)
            if part and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local pos = part.Position
                if flags.aimLead then
                    local _, _, hrp = getChar()
                    local r = chr:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if r and hrp then pos += r.AssemblyLinearVelocity * ((pos - hrp.Position).Magnitude / 500) * (flags.aimLeadAmt / 100) end
                end
                local sp, on = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                if on then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - ctr).Magnitude
                    if d <= maxPx and (not bd or d < bd) then best, bd = { part = part, pos = pos }, d end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function slam(plr, mode)
    local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local seat = getSeat()
    if not seat then notify("! sit in a car") return end

    local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local root = seat.AssemblyRootPart or seat
    pcall(function() seat:SetNetworkOwner(lp) end)

    local anchor = (mode ~= "Direct")
    if anchor then root.Anchored = true end

    local cf
    if mode == "Slam" then cf = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
    elseif mode == "Spin" then cf = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
    elseif mode == "Drop" then cf = CFrame.new(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0))
    else cf = nil end

    if cf then
        if model then pcall(function() model:PivotTo(cf) end) end
        root.CFrame = cf
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end

    task.defer(function()
        if anchor then
            RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if root.Parent then root.Anchored = false end
            RS.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if not root.Parent then return end
        if mode == "Slam" then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-400, 400), 900, math.random(-400, 400))
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(1400, 1400, 1400)
        elseif mode == "Spin" then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 550, 0)
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(2200, 2200, 2200)
        elseif mode == "Drop" then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -1900, 0)
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(1600, 1600, 0)
        elseif mode == "Direct" then
            pcall(function() hrp:SetNetworkOwner(lp) end)
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-1000, 1000), 900, math.random(-1000, 1000))
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-1400, 1400), math.random(-1400, 1400), math.random(-1400, 1400))
            task.delay(1.5, function() pcall(function() hrp:SetNetworkOwner(plr) end) end)
        end
    end)
end

local function slamTarget()
    local p = locked
    if not p or not p.Parent or not p.Character then
        local h = nearestPlayer()
        p = h and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(h.Parent)
    end
    if not p then notify("! no target") return end
    slam(p, flags.slammode)
end

local function slamAll(radius)
    local _, _, hrp = getChar()
    if not hrp then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp then
            local t = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if t and (t.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude < radius then
                task.spawn(function() slam(p, flags.slammode) end)
                task.wait(0.06)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function flingPlayer(plr, mode)
    local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-500, 500), math.random(-500, 500), 0)

local function bring(plr)

local function findPOI(keys, radius)
    local chr = lp.Character
    local _, _, hrp = getChar()
    local best, bd
    for _, d in ipairs(WS:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and not (chr and d:IsDescendantOf(chr)) then
            local n = d.Name:lower()
            for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
                if n:find(k, 1, true) then
                    if not radius or not hrp then return d end
                    local dist = (d.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < radius and (not bd or dist < bd) then best, bd = d, dist end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

    Stage.Text = "Stage: " .. stage
end

local function teleport(position)
    local character = Player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if root then
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    end
end

local function interact(prompt)
    if not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then
        return false
    end

    if typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
        fireproximityprompt(prompt)
        return true
    end

    updateStatus("Error", "Prompt function unavailable")
    Running = false
    return false
end

local function waitCancelable(seconds)
    local elapsed = 0

    while elapsed < seconds and Running do
        task.wait(0.1)
        elapsed += 0.1
    end

    return Running
end

local function farm()
    while Running do

        -- NPC QUEST
        updateStatus("Running", "Traveling to NPC")
        teleport(NPCPosition)

        if not waitCancelable(1) then break end

        updateStatus("Running", "Starting quest")

        if not interact(NPCPrompt) then break end

        if not waitCancelable(7.5) then break end

        -- FIND RELIC
        updateStatus("Running", "Searching for relic")

        local relic = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PersonalRelic")

        while not relic and Running do
            task.wait(0.5)
            relic = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PersonalRelic")
        end

        if not Running then break end

        -- TELEPORT TO RELIC
        updateStatus("Running", "Traveling to relic")

        teleport(
            (relic:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)).Position
        )

        -- WAIT BEFORE COLLECTION
        if not waitCancelable(5) then break end

        -- COLLECT
        updateStatus("Running", "Collecting relic")

        local relicPrompt = relic:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(
            "ProximityPrompt", true
        )

        if not interact(relicPrompt) then break end

        -- WAIT FOR COLLECTION CUTSCENE
        if not waitCancelable(4) then break end

        -- RETURN TO NPC
        updateStatus("Running", "Returning to NPC")

        teleport(NPCPosition)

        -- WAIT FOR NPC COOLDOWN
        updateStatus("Running", "Waiting for NPC cooldown")

        if not waitCancelable(15) then break end

        -- TURN IN RELIC
        updateStatus("Running", "Turning in relic")

        if not interact(NPCPrompt) then break end

        -- WAIT FOR THANK-YOU DIALOGUE
        if not waitCancelable(5) then break end
    end

    Running = false
    updateStatus("Stopped", "Waiting")
end

-- BUTTON CONNECTIONS
StartButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if Running then return end

    Running = true

    updateStatus("Running", "Starting")
    task.spawn(farm)
end)

StopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Running = false
    updateStatus("Stopped", "Waiting")
end)

Minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Minimized = not Minimized

    Status.Visible = not Minimized
    Stage.Visible = not Minimized
    StartButton.Visible = not Minimized
    StopButton.Visible = not Minimized
    Creator.Visible = not Minimized

    Main.Size = Minimized
        and UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 40)
        or UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 205)

    Minimize.Text = Minimized and "+" or "-"
end)

-- CLOSE ENTIRE GUI
Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Running = false
    GUI:Destroy()
end)

scripts.author: finderisgone
scripts.summary: F6 toggle for auto surf
scripts.code:
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.AutoSurf and env.AutoSurf.Stop then env.AutoSurf.Stop() end

assert(type(getgc) == "function" and type(getfenv) == "function",
    "AutoSurf: this environment does not expose getgc/getfenv")
assert(debug and type(debug.getupvalues) == "function"
    and type(debug.setupvalue) == "function",
    "AutoSurf: debug.getupvalues/setupvalue are required")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local surf = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Surf", 15)
assert(surf, "AutoSurf: Surf folder not found in this game")
local controller = player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("SurfController", 15)
assert(controller, "AutoSurf: SurfController not loaded")
local Config = require(surf:WaitForChild("Config"))
local WaveField = require(surf:WaitForChild("WaveField"))
local Boards = require(surf:WaitForChild("Boards"))
local Spots = require(surf:WaitForChild("Spots"))
local Tutor = require(surf:WaitForChild("BalanceTutor"))

local function functionName(fn)
    if debug.info then
        local ok, name = pcall(debug.info, fn, "n")
        if ok and name and name ~= "" then return name end
    end
    if debug.getinfo then
        local ok, info = pcall(debug.getinfo, fn)
        if ok and info then return info.name end
    end
end

local functions = {}
local owned = {}
for _, value in pairs(getgc()) do
    if type(value) == "function" then
        local ok, scope = pcall(getfenv, value)
        if ok and scope and rawget(scope, "script") == controller then
            owned[#owned + 1] = value
            local name = functionName(value)
            if name then functions[name] = value end
        end
    end
end
local popUp = functions.popUp
local window = functions.popUpWindow
local pump = functions.pump
local inputs = functions.inputs
assert(popUp and window and pump and inputs,
    "AutoSurf: controller functions were not found; this game/build is unsupported")

-- Verify the exported popUp closure layout before relying on its state.
local function readState()
    local values = debug.getupvalues(popUp)
    local heading, forward, position, stats, velocity = values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4], values[5]
    if typeof(forward) ~= "Vector3" or (forward - Config.FORWARD).Magnitude > 0.01 then
        error("AutoSurf: popUp closure layout changed; stopped")
    end
    if heading ~= nil and typeof(heading) ~= "Vector3" then
        error("AutoSurf: unexpected heading state; stopped")
    end
    if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(velocity) ~= "Vector3"
        or type(stats) ~= "table" or type(stats.PUMP_COOLDOWN) ~= "number" then
        return nil
    end
    return heading, position, velocity, stats
end

local api = { Enabled = true }
local connections, patches = {}, {}
local stopped = false
local originalDrive = Tutor.drive
local character, mode, wave, heading, position, velocity, stats
local balance = Vector2.zero
local lastPump, lastPop, nextUpdate = -math.huge, -math.huge, 0
local paddleLeft, paddleRight = false, false

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "AutoSurfControl"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 100
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 100)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 36, 45)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 195)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 14
button.Parent = gui
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
corner.Parent = button

local function surfMode()
    character = player.Character
    if stopped or not api.Enabled or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
        or player:GetAttribute("SurfReplay") or player:GetAttribute("SurfTravelBusy") then return nil end
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("SurfboardActive") then return nil end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
    local current = character:GetAttribute("SurfMode")
    if current ~= "Paddle" and current ~= "Stand" then return nil end
    -- These board types have separate launch/flight controls.
    local board = Boards.Get(player:GetAttribute("BoardType"))
    if board and (board.kite or board.skim or board.foil) then return nil end
    return current
end

local function automatedInputs(...)
    local current = surfMode()
    if not current then return inputs(...) end
    if current == "Paddle" then return true, paddleLeft, false, paddleRight end
    return false, false, false, false
end

-- Change only controller closure references. Record each slot for restoration.
for _, fn in ipairs(owned) do
    local ok, values = pcall(debug.getupvalues, fn)
    if ok then
        for index, value in pairs(values) do
            if value == inputs then
                patches[#patches + 1] = { fn, index, value }
            end
        end
    end
end
assert(#patches > 0, "AutoSurf: no controller input references found")

local function assistedDrive(...)
    if surfMode() == "Stand" then
        -- The game's existing assist hook owns balance integration. Staying
        -- below 0.22 leaves a large margin beneath its magnitude-1 wipeout.
        return balance, Vector2.zero
    end
    return originalDrive(...)
end

function api.Stop()
    if stopped then return end
    stopped = true
    api.Enabled = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    for _, patch in ipairs(patches) do
        pcall(function()
            if debug.getupvalues(patch[1])[patch[2]] == automatedInputs then
                debug.setupvalue(patch[1], patch[2], patch[3])
            end
        end)
    end
    if Tutor.drive == assistedDrive then Tutor.drive = originalDrive end
    gui:Destroy()
    if env.AutoSurf == api then env.AutoSurf = nil end
end

local ok, failure = pcall(function()
    for _, patch in ipairs(patches) do
        debug.setupvalue(patch[1], patch[2], automatedInputs)
        assert(debug.getupvalues(patch[1])[patch[2]] == automatedInputs,
            "AutoSurf: executor could not replace controller inputs")
    end
    Tutor.drive = assistedDrive
end)
if not ok then api.Stop(); error(failure) end
env.AutoSurf = api

local function update()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < nextUpdate then return end
    nextUpdate = now + 1 / 30
    mode = surfMode()
    if not api.Enabled then
        button.Text = "AutoSurf OFF  |  F6"
        balance = Vector2.zero
        return
    end
    if not mode then
        button.Text = "AutoSurf ON  |  waiting for surf"
        balance = Vector2.zero
        return
    end
    heading, position, velocity, stats = readState()
    if not heading then button.Text = "AutoSurf ON  |  waiting for rider"; return end
    wave = WaveField.Sample(position, WaveField.Now())
    local spot = Spots.Get(Spots.At(position))
    local lateral = (position - spot.origin):Dot(Config.LATERAL)
    local halfWidth = Config.SEGMENTS * Config.SEG_WIDTH / 2
    -- A modest shoulder line, with a gradual turn back inside the wave field.
    local shoulder = math.clamp(-lateral / math.max(halfWidth * 0.65, 1), -1, 1) * 0.25
    local desired = (Config.FORWARD + Config.LATERAL * shoulder).Unit
    local errorAngle = math.atan2(heading:Cross(desired).Y, heading:Dot(desired))
    -- Paddle rotation: A adds yaw, D subtracts it.
    paddleLeft = errorAngle > 0.06
    paddleRight = errorAngle < -0.06
    if mode == "Paddle" then
        balance = Vector2.zero
        button.Text = "AutoSurf ON  |  catching a wave"
        if now - lastPop > 0.8 and window(wave) then
            lastPop = now
            popUp(wave)
        end
    else
        balance = Vector2.new(math.clamp(-errorAngle * 1.4 / math.max(stats.CARVE_RATE or 2, 0.1), -0.22, 0.22), 0)
        button.Text = "AutoSurf ON  |  riding + balancing"
        if wave.onFace and wave.h > 0.4 and wave.c > 0
            and (wave.dhds or 0) < -0.1
            and now - lastPump >= math.max(stats.PUMP_COOLDOWN, 0.25)
            and velocity.Magnitude < wave.c * 1.35 then
            lastPump = now
            pump() -- Original function retains the board's cooldown checks.
        end
    end
end

local function toggle()
    api.Enabled = not api.Enabled
    balance = Vector2.zero
    nextUpdate = 0
end
connections[#connections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(toggle)
connections[#connections + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 then toggle() end
end)
connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
    local success, reason = pcall(update)
    if not success then api.Stop(); warn("AutoSurf stopped: " .. tostring(reason)) end
end)
connections[#connections + 1] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    balance = Vector2.zero
    paddleLeft, paddleRight = false, false
    lastPump, lastPop = -math.huge, -math.huge
end)
button.Text = "AutoSurf ON  |  waiting for surf"
print("AutoSurf ready. Mount a normal surfboard; F6 toggles. AutoSurf.Stop() unloads.")

    UDim.new(0, 8)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

Track(Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = Main.Position
    end
end))

Track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end))

Track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end))

--==================================================
-- NAME TAGS
--==================================================

local function CreateNameTag(obj)
    local adornee

    if obj:IsA("Model") then
        adornee = obj:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        adornee = obj
    end

    if not adornee then
        return nil
    end

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "NeonHub_NameTag"
    billboard.Adornee = adornee
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 30)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = Gui

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = obj.Name
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 13
    label.Parent = billboard

    return billboard
end

--==================================================
-- HIGHLIGHTS
--==================================================

local function AddHighlight(obj, category)
    if not obj:IsA("Model") and not obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        return
    end

    if Highlights[category][obj] then
        return
    end

    local isMonster = category == "Twisteds ESP"

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "NeonHub_ESP"
    highlight.Adornee = obj
    highlight.FillTransparency = 1
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0

    highlight.OutlineColor = isMonster
        and Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 35)
        or Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)

    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    highlight.Parent = Gui

    local tag

    if category ~= "Items ESP" then
        tag = CreateNameTag(obj)
    end

    Highlights[category][obj] = {
        Highlight = highlight,
        Tag = tag
    }
end

--==================================================
-- CLEANUP
--==================================================

local function RemoveHighlights(category)
    for obj, data in pairs(Highlights[category]) do
        if data.Highlight then
            data.Highlight:Destroy()
        end

        if data.Tag then
            data.Tag:Destroy()
        end
    end

    Highlights[category] = {}
end

--==================================================
-- UNIVERSAL MONSTER SCANNER
--==================================================

local function ContainsKeyword(name, keywords)
    name = name:lower()

    for _, keyword in ipairs(keywords) do
        if name:find(keyword, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function IsMonsterModel(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("Model") then
        return false
    end

    local current = obj
    local folderFound = false
    local nameFound = false

    while current and current ~= Workspace do
        local name = current.Name:lower()

        -- EXCLUSIONS

        if ContainsKeyword(name, ExcludedNames) then
            return false
        end

        -- MONSTER FOLDER DETECTION

        if ContainsKeyword(name, MonsterFolders) then
            folderFound = true
        end

        -- MONSTER NAME DETECTION

        if current:IsA("Model")
            and ContainsKeyword(name, MonsterKeywords) then
            nameFound = true
        end

        current = current.Parent
    end

    return folderFound or nameFound
end

local function ScanTwistedMonsters()
    local category = "Twisteds ESP"

    if not Enabled[category] then
        return
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if IsMonsterModel(obj) then
            AddHighlight(obj, category)
        end
    end
end

--==================================================
-- GENERAL MATCHING
--==================================================

local function MatchesCategory(obj, category)
    local settings = Categories[category]

    if not settings or not settings.keywords then
        return false
    end

    local name = obj.Name:lower()

    for _, keyword in ipairs(settings.keywords) do
        if name:find(keyword, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER ESP
--==================================================

local function ScanPlayers()
    local category = "Players ESP"

    if not Enabled[category] then
        return
    end

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= Player and otherPlayer.Character then
            AddHighlight(otherPlayer.Character, category)
        end
    end
end

--==================================================
-- GENERAL SCANNING
--==================================================

local function ScanCategory(category)
    if not Enabled[category] then
        return
    end

    if category == "Twisteds ESP" then
        ScanTwistedMonsters()
        return
    end

    if category == "Players ESP" then
        ScanPlayers()
        return
    end

    local function Scan(container)
        for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if MatchesCategory(obj, category) then
                AddHighlight(obj, category)
            end
        end
    end

    Scan(Workspace)
    Scan(ReplicatedStorage)
end

--==================================================
-- BUTTONS
--==================================================

local List = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
List.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -75)
List.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 65)
List.BackgroundTransparency = 1
List.BorderSizePixel = 0
List.ScrollBarThickness = 4

List.Parent = Main

Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 7)
Layout.Parent = List

for category in pairs(Categories) do

    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 36)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 38, 55)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 230, 245)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    button.TextSize = 13
    button.Text = category .. " [OFF]"
    button.Parent = List

    Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius =
        UDim.new(0, 7)

    Track(button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Enabled[category] = not Enabled[category]

        if Enabled[category] then
            button.Text = category .. " [ON]"
            button.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(15, 75, 135)

            ScanCategory(category)
        else
            button.Text = category .. " [OFF]"
            button.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(30, 38, 55)

            RemoveHighlights(category)
        end
    end))
end

--==================================================
-- AUTOMATIC RESCANNING
--==================================================

task.spawn(function()
    while Running and Gui.Parent do
        for category in pairs(Categories) do
            if Enabled[category] then
                ScanCategory(category)
            end
        end

        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- UNLOAD EVERYTHING
--==================================================

local function Unload()
    if not Running then
        return
    end

    Running = false
    dragging = false

    for category in pairs(Categories) do
        Enabled[category] = false
        RemoveHighlights(category)
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(Connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end

    table.clear(Connections)

    Gui:Destroy()

    print("NEON HUB completely unloaded!")
end

Track(Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Unload))

print("NEON HUB V3 loaded successfully!")

	local windowDragging, windowDragStart, windowStartPos = false, nil, nil
	topBarDrag.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			windowDragging = true
			windowDragStart = input.Position
			windowStartPos = mainFrame.Position
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and windowDragging then
			local delta = input.Position - windowDragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(windowStartPos.X.Scale, windowStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X, windowStartPos.Y.Scale, windowStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
			local targetRotation = math.clamp(delta.X * 0.1, -6, 6)
			mainFrame.Rotation = mainFrame.Rotation + (targetRotation - mainFrame.Rotation) * 0.2
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			windowDragging = false
		end
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if mainFrame.Visible and not windowDragging then

		if states.ESP then

					local char = p.Character
					if not char:FindFirstChild("KM_ESP") then

		local isPlaying = customSoundInstance and customSoundInstance.IsPlaying
		for i, barData in ipairs(audioBars) do
			local width = 28
			local height = 6
			if isPlaying then
				width = math.clamp(math.floor(22 + (customMusicVolume * 10)), 15, 32)
				local wave = math.sin((tick() * barData.speed) + barData.offset)
				local scaleMultiplier = 50 + (customMusicVolume * 220)
				height = math.clamp(math.floor(math.abs(wave) * scaleMultiplier), 8, 290)
			end
			barData.frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
		end
	end)

	local function giveBombAndPump(targetPlayer)
		local myChar = player.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character
		local targetRoot = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not myRoot or not targetRoot then return end

		local savedCFrameRef = myRoot.CFrame
		myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1.5)
		task.wait(0.08)

		pcall(function()
			local bombTool = myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") or player.Backpack:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			if bombTool then bombTool.Parent = targetPlayer.Backpack end
		end)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, i * 2, 0)
			task.wait(0.04)
		end

		task.wait(0.08)
		if myRoot and myRoot.Parent then myRoot.CFrame = savedCFrameRef end
	end

	local function populatePlayerList()
		for _, child in ipairs(playerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
		end

		local count = 0
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= player then
				count = count + 1
				local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
				pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 26)
				pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 38)
				pBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
				pBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
				pBtn.TextSize = 11
				pBtn.Text = "  " .. p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")"
				pBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				pBtn.ZIndex = 2
				pBtn.Parent = playerListFrame

				local pCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
				pCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
				pCorner.Parent = pBtn

				local pStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
				pStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
				pStroke.Thickness = 1.2
				pStroke.Parent = pBtn

				pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					playClickSound()
					local origText = pBtn.Text
					pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 80)
					pBtn.Text = "  Dano & Pompujesz: " .. p.Name .. "!"
					showSuccessNotification("Bombę dano graczowi " .. p.Name)
					giveBombAndPump(p)
					task.delay(0.9, function()
						if pBtn and pBtn.Parent then
							pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 38)
							pBtn.Text = origText
						end
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		playerListFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 30)
	end

	refreshBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		playClickSound()
		populatePlayerList()
		showSuccessNotification("Odświeżono listę!")
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(populatePlayerList)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(populatePlayerList)
	populatePlayerList()
end

scripts.title: Minecraft textures
scripts.author: itzsum1tblox
scripts.summary: Ported for mobile by itzsum1tblox Original made by 66 mods
scripts.code:
-- SETTINGS

local PACK_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itzsum1tblox/Rivals-minecraft-texture-itzsum1tblox-/main/Minecraft_Classic_Pack_v1.2%28day%29.json"
local PATTERN_ID = "136887158756561" -- the game's map pattern
local TILE_STUDS = 4                 -- size of one block in studs (lower = smaller blocks)
local AUTO_PATTERN = false           -- finds the game's other map patterns (fixes half map)
local AUTO_MIN_COUNT = 25
local FALLBACK_PARTS = false         -- covers surfaces that are still bare
local HIDE_OTHER_TEXTURES = false
local MIN_SIZE = 4
local MIN_FACE = 2
local MAX_PARTS = 20000
local TINT = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 175) -- brightness of blocks (lower = darker, fixes washed-out walls)

-- LOADING SCREEN / LOGO
local LOGO_MODE = "custom"           -- "custom" = your logo.png, "original" = game's logo, "remove" = hide it
local LOGO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itzsum1tblox/Rivals-minecraft-texture-itzsum1tblox-/main/logo.png"
local TEXT_SWAP = true               -- changes any text saying "66mods" into NAME_TEXT
local NAME_TEXT = "itzsum1tblox"

-- Folders directly under Workspace that should NOT get blocks (the lobby)
local EXCLUDE_NAMES = {"Lobby", "LobbyMap", "Hub", "Spawn"}

local function log(m) print("[MC] " .. tostring(m)) end

local EXCLUDE = {}
for _, n in ipairs(EXCLUDE_NAMES) do EXCLUDE[n:lower()] = true end

local function topOf(inst)
local top = inst
while top.Parent and top.Parent ~= workspace do top = top.Parent end
return top
end

local function excluded(inst)
if not inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
return EXCLUDE[topOf(inst).Name:lower()] == true
end

-- face sizes + square tiles that line up with a part's edges (used for bare surfaces)
local function faceSize(part, face)
local s = part.Size
if face == Enum.NormalId.Top then
if part:IsA("WedgePart") then
return s.X, math.sqrt(s.Y * s.Y + s.Z * s.Z)
end
return s.X, s.Z
elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
return s.X, s.Z
elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Front or face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
return s.X, s.Y
end
return s.Z, s.Y
end

local function plainEnough(part)
if part.ClassName == "WedgePart" then return true end
return part.ClassName == "Part" and part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block
end

local function fitScale(part, face)
local a, b = faceSize(part, face)
local s = math.max(1, math.min(TILE_STUDS, a, b))
local nu = math.max(1, math.floor(a / s + 0.5))
local nv = math.max(1, math.floor(b / s + 0.5))
return a / nu, b / nv
end


---

-- BLOCK TILE (built in, no download needed)

local B64 = ""

local function decode(s)
local chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local map = {}
for i = 1, 64 do map[chars:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end
local out, acc, bits = {}, 0, 0
for c in s:gmatch("[A-Za-z0-9+/]") do
acc = acc * 64 + map[c]
bits = bits + 6
if bits >= 8 then
bits = bits - 8
local d = 2 ^ bits
local byte = math.floor(acc / d)
acc = acc - byte * d
out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
end
end
return table.concat(out)
end

local TILE
do
local ok, err = pcall(function()
writefile("mc_tile_v2.png", decode(B64))
TILE = getcustomasset("mc_tile_v2.png")
end)
if not ok or not TILE then
warn("[MC] Tile failed: " .. tostring(err))
return
end
end


---

-- PACK (sounds, icons, skies) + MAP PATTERN -> BLOCKS

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local stats, swaps, done = {}, 0, {}
local fallbackParts = 0
local resolved = {}

local function dedupe(parent, face)
if not parent then return end
for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
if c.Name == "_McBlock" and c:IsA("Decal") and c.Face == face then
c:Destroy()
end
end
end

local function applyTile(inst, p)
stats[inst.ClassName] = (stats[inst.ClassName] or 0) + 1
if inst:IsA("Texture") then
inst.Texture = TILE
inst.StudsPerTileU = TILE_STUDS
inst.StudsPerTileV = TILE_STUDS
inst.Transparency = 0
inst.Color3 = TINT
dedupe(inst.Parent, inst.Face)
elseif inst:IsA("Decal") then
if done[inst] then return end
done[inst] = true
local t = Instance.new("Texture")
t.Name = "_McTile"
t.Face = inst.Face
t.Texture = TILE
t.StudsPerTileU = TILE_STUDS
t.StudsPerTileV = TILE_STUDS
t.Color3 = TINT
t.Parent = inst.Parent
inst.Transparency = 1
dedupe(inst.Parent, inst.Face)
else
inst[p] = TILE
end
end

local function report()
local list = {}
for k, v in pairs(stats) do list[#list + 1] = k .. "=" .. v end
log("swaps=" .. swaps .. " | map pattern replaced: " .. (#list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "none yet") .. " | extra parts: " .. fallbackParts)
end

local PROPS = {
Sound = {"SoundId"},
ImageLabel = {"Image"},
ImageButton = {"Image", "HoverImage", "PressedImage"},
Decal = {"Texture"},
Texture = {"Texture"},
ParticleEmitter = {"Texture"},
Beam = {"Texture"},
Trail = {"Texture"},
MeshPart = {"TextureID"},
SpecialMesh = {"TextureId"},
Sky = {"SkyboxBk", "SkyboxDn", "SkyboxFt", "SkyboxLf", "SkyboxRt", "SkyboxUp"},
}

local function trySwap(inst, p)
local ok3, v = pcall(function() return inst[p] end)
if not ok3 or type(v) ~= "string" or v:find("^rbxasset://") then return end
local id = v:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or v:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
local new = id and resolved[id]
if new == nil then return end
if new == TILE and excluded(inst) then return end
swaps = swaps + 1
if new == TILE then
pcall(applyTile, inst, p)
else
pcall(function() inst[p] = new end)
end
end

-- changes "66mods" text (any capitalization) into NAME_TEXT
local function fixText(inst)
if not (inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
local function fix()
local ok4, t = pcall(function() return inst.Text end)
if ok4 and type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" then
local new, n = string.gsub(t, "66%s*[Mm][Oo][Dd][Ss]", NAME_TEXT)
if n > 0 then pcall(function() inst.Text = new end) end
end
end
fix()
inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(fix)
end

local function handle(inst)
if TEXT_SWAP then fixText(inst) end
local props = PROPS[inst.ClassName]
if not props then return end
for _, p in ipairs(props) do
trySwap(inst, p)
inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p):Connect(function() trySwap(inst, p) end)
end
end

local ok, err = pcall(function()
local rules = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(PACK_URL)).replacement_rules
local cache = {}

local function getAsset(url)
if cache[url] then return cache[url] end
local name = "mcpack_" .. url:match("([^/]+)$")
if not isfile(name) then writefile(name, game:HttpGet(url)) end
cache[url] = getcustomasset(name)
return cache[url]
end

local good, bad = 0, 0
for _, r in ipairs(rules) do
if r.enabled then
local value
if r.mode == "id" then
value = ""
elseif r.cdn_url and not r.cdn_url:match("%.obj$") then
local ok2, res = pcall(getAsset, r.cdn_url)
if ok2 and res then
value = res
good = good + 1
else
bad = bad + 1
warn("[MC] Failed: " .. tostring(r.name))
end
end
if value ~= nil then
for _, id in ipairs(r.replace_ids) do
resolved[string.format("%.0f", id)] = value -- full digits, no e+14
end
end
end
end
resolved[PATTERN_ID] = TILE -- map pattern becomes blocks
log("files ok=" .. good .. " failed=" .. bad)

-- LOADING SCREEN / LOGO (the 66mods logo images from the pack)

local pointer

    local kind = input.UserInputType

    if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        return
    end
    if dragging then return end

    pointer = input
    dragging = true
    moved = false
    pointerStart = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    buttonStart = button.AbsolutePosition
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end

    local mouseMove =
        pointer.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

    if not mouseMove and input ~= pointer then return end

    local position = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
    local delta = position - pointerStart

    if delta.Magnitude >= 7 then moved = true end
    if not moved then return end

    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
    local size = button.AbsoluteSize + Vector2.new(0, 202 - 100)

    button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
        math.clamp(
            buttonStart.X + delta.X,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.X - size.X - 8)
        ),
        math.clamp(
            buttonStart.Y + delta.Y,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - size.Y - 8)
        )
    )
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input == pointer then
        dragging = false
        pointer = nil
