    releaseCharacter()
    homeCFrame = nil
    title.Text = "AUTO"
    status.Text = "CLICK TO START"
end

local function heading()
    local right = root.CFrame.RightVector
    return math.atan2(-right.Z, right.X)
end

local function startCycle()
    -- Keep the same physical anchor for the whole mount, not each trick.
    if stabilityHealth then stabilityHealth() end
    baseHeight = root.Position.Y
    targetHeight = baseHeight + liftHeight
    turned = 0
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    setPhase("up", "RISING")
end

local function connectCharacter()
    local character = player.Character
    local newRoot = character
        and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local newHumanoid = character
        and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not newRoot or not newHumanoid
        or newHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    root = newRoot
    humanoid = newHumanoid
    oldAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
    humanoid.AutoRotate = false

    fixedX = root.Position.X
    fixedZ = root.Position.Z
    -- Keep the first valid home point across accidental falls / respawns.
    -- A fresh run resets this value; restarting a character does not.
    if not homeCFrame then
        homeCFrame = root.CFrame
    end
    if newHumanoid.SeatPart then
        -- Recovery checks that this seat is our actual G2 next frame.
        startCycle()
    else
        -- Don't lift/spin the player while looking for the G2 scooter.
        setPhase("recovery", "FINDING G2")
    end
end

local function holdUpright(dt)
    local angle = heading()
    local height = root.Position.Y

    root.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(fixedX, height, fixedZ)
        * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)

    local verticalSpeed = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    -- Cap speed to the remaining distance per physics step. This allows
    -- turbo movement without overshooting the 2-stud travel repeatedly.
    local stepTime = math.max(dt, 1 / 240)

    if phase == "up" then
        verticalSpeed = math.clamp(
            (targetHeight - height) / stepTime, -riseSpeed, riseSpeed
        )
    elseif phase == "spin" then
        -- Preserve the original small stabilization while rotating.
        verticalSpeed = math.clamp(
            (targetHeight - height) * 8, -6, 6
        )
    elseif phase == "down" then
        local distanceDown = height - baseHeight
        if distanceDown > 0.16 then
            verticalSpeed = -math.min(descentSpeed, distanceDown / stepTime)
        else
            verticalSpeed = 0
        end
    end

    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
        0, verticalSpeed, 0
    )
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
        0, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y, 0
    )
end

local function beginLanding()
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    descentObserved = false
    setPhase("down", "LANDING")
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
        0, -descentSpeed, 0
    )
end

-- חזרה לקורקינט של השחקן בלבד
local function childPath(parent, names)
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        parent = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    return parent
end

local function ownRideSeat()
    return childPath(workspace, {
        "Rides", "Ride_" .. player.Name, "DriveSeat"
    })
end

-- KURKIN LIFE currently labels its G2 entry prompt "Kuki G2".
-- Accept both known display labels while still rejecting other scooter models.
local function isG2Prompt(prompt)
    return prompt ~= nil
        and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
        and (prompt.ObjectText == "G2" or prompt.ObjectText == "Kuki G2")
end

-- STABILITY GUARD (V10): resist horizontal drift without touching vertical
-- motion, spinning, collision flags, vehicle anchoring, or server ownership.
-- The original rider/anti-break logic remains intact. All objects below are
-- local, created only after a real G2 mount, and removed during recovery/OFF.
local guard = {
    root = nil, seat = nil, attachment = nil, align = nil,
    ride = nil, rideAnchor = nil, elapsed = 0, driftTime = 0, peakRideDrift = 0,
    created = 0, failure = nil, lastLog = 0,
    completed = 0, failed = 0, failedInRow = 0, lastCompletedAt = 0,
    sawSpin = false, alerted = false, idle = false
}
local GUARD_DRIFT_ALERT = 2.5  -- alert for large, sustained model movement
local GUARD_DRIFT_SECONDS = 1.5
local GUARD_LOG_EVERY = 30

stabilityHealth = function()
    guard.sawSpin = false
end

releaseStability = function()
    if guard.align then
        pcall(function() guard.align:Destroy() end)
    end
    if guard.attachment then
        pcall(function() guard.attachment:Destroy() end)
    end
    guard.root, guard.seat, guard.ride = nil, nil, nil
    guard.attachment, guard.align, guard.rideAnchor = nil, nil, nil
    guard.driftTime, guard.peakRideDrift, guard.elapsed = 0, 0, 0
end

local function setupStability(seat)
    if not root or root.Anchored or not root.Parent then return end
    releaseStability()
    guard.root, guard.seat = root, seat
    local ride = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local rides = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rides")
    if ride and rides and ride.Parent == rides then
        guard.ride = ride
        guard.rideAnchor = ride:GetPivot().Position
    end
    guard.created = os.clock()

    -- A bounded world-space planar correction. Y-force is exactly zero,
    -- so it cannot fight the 15 studs/sec ascent/descent or jump vertically.
    -- Soft physics control avoids the repeated PivotTo feedback seen in V9.
    local attach, align
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        attach = Instance.new("Attachment")
        attach.Name = "KL_StableXZ_Attachment"
        attach.Parent = root
        align = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
        align.Name = "KL_StableXZ_Planar"
        align.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
        align.Attachment0 = attach
        align.RigidityEnabled = false
        align.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
        align.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
        align.ForceRelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        local force = math.clamp(root.AssemblyMass * 380, 5000, 70000)
        align.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(force, 0, force)
        align.MaxVelocity = 8
        align.Responsiveness = 28
        align.Position = Vector3.new(fixedX, root.Position.Y, fixedZ)
        align.Parent = root
    end)
    if ok then
        guard.attachment, guard.align = attach, align
        guardStatus.Text = "GUARD ON | 0 SUCCESS"
        print("[KL GUARD] Horizontal stabilization active. Vertical force=0.")
    else
        if align then pcall(function() align:Destroy() end) end
        if attach then pcall(function() attach:Destroy() end) end
        guard.failure = tostring(err)
        guardStatus.Text = "GUARD FALLBACK: ROOT LOCK"
        warn("[KL GUARD] Optional planar assist unavailable; V10 root lock remains: ", err)
    end
end

maintainStability = function(dt)
    if not enabled or not root or not humanoid then
        if guard.root then releaseStability() end
        return false
    end
    local seat = ownRideSeat()
    local prompt = seat and seat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    if recoveryActive or phase == "recovery" or not seat
        or not isG2Prompt(prompt) or humanoid.SeatPart ~= seat then
        if guard.root then releaseStability() end
        return false
    end
    if guard.root ~= root or guard.seat ~= seat then
        setupStability(seat)
    end

    -- Read the stabilized rider position after the existing rotation update.
    -- The alignment force has no effect on Y; its target follows current Y.
    if guard.align and guard.align.Parent and guard.align.Attachment0 then
        guard.align.Position = Vector3.new(fixedX, root.Position.Y, fixedZ)
    end

    guard.elapsed += dt
    if guard.elapsed < 0.2 then return false end
    local period = guard.elapsed
    guard.elapsed = 0
    if not guard.rideAnchor or not guard.ride or not guard.ride.Parent then return false end

    -- Measure actual MODEL displacement in world XZ, without confusing
    -- normal yaw/spin with translation. Do not compare world seat position
    -- to a fixed point: the seat may rotate around the scooter pivot.
    local pivot = guard.ride:GetPivot().Position
    local home = guard.rideAnchor
    local drift = (Vector2.new(pivot.X, pivot.Z)
        - Vector2.new(home.X, home.Z)).Magnitude
    guard.peakRideDrift = math.max(guard.peakRideDrift, drift)
    if drift >= GUARD_DRIFT_ALERT then
        guard.driftTime += period
    else
        guard.driftTime = 0
    end
    if guard.driftTime >= GUARD_DRIFT_SECONDS and not guard.alerted then
        guard.alerted = true
        warn(string.format("[KL GUARD] Persistent scooter model drift: %.2f studs. Check seat/physics.", drift))
        notify("G2 DRIFT DETECTED")
    end
    if guard.alerted then
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("G2 DRIFT! PEAK %.2f | OK %d", guard.peakRideDrift, guard.completed)
    else
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("GUARD %s | OK %d | MOVE %.2f", guard.align and "ON" or "FALLBACK", guard.completed, drift)
    end
    if os.clock() - guard.lastLog >= GUARD_LOG_EVERY then
        guard.lastLog = os.clock()
        print(string.format(
            "[KL GUARD] complete=%d failed=%d peak_model_drift=%.2f mounted=%s phase=%s assist=%s",
            guard.completed, guard.failed, guard.peakRideDrift,
            tostring(humanoid.SeatPart == seat), phase, tostring(guard.align ~= nil)
        ))
    end
    return false
end

-- A prolonged lack of rotations is a genuine failure; do not silently
-- report that 10 hours of useful work occurred if the game blocked spinning.
local function flagSpinFailure(reason)
    guard.failed += 1
    guard.failedInRow += 1
    warn(string.format("[KL GUARD] spin failed (%d consecutive): %s", guard.failedInRow, reason))
    if guard.failedInRow >= 3 then
        stop()
        title.Text = "ALERT"
        status.Text = "SPIN BLOCKED - CHECK"
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("0 PROGRESS | SUCCESS %d", guard.completed)
        notify("SPIN BLOCKED")
        return true
    end
    beginLanding()
    return false
end

stabilityWatchdog = function()
    -- Failed spawn/mount/recovery must not run silently for hours.
    -- Reset only after a fully measured 5300-degree spin, not on UI clicks.
    if not enabled then return false end
    if guard.lastCompletedAt > 0 and os.clock() - guard.lastCompletedAt <= 150 then
        return false
    end
    if guard.lastCompletedAt > 0 and os.clock() - guard.lastCompletedAt > 150 then
        stop()
        title.Text = "ALERT"
        status.Text = "NO COMPLETED SPIN"
        guardStatus.Text = string.format("GUARD STOPPED | OK %d", guard.completed)
        notify("AUTO STOPPED - NO SPIN")
        warn("[KL GUARD] No completed spin for 150 seconds: stopped instead of silently idling")
        return true
    end
    return false
end


local function visible(object)
    if not object then return false end
    local current = object
    while current and current ~= playerGui do
        if current:IsA("GuiObject") and not current.Visible then
            return false
        end
        if current:IsA("ScreenGui") and not current.Enabled then
            return false
        end
        current = current.Parent
    end
    return current == playerGui
end

-- SILENT G2 SPAWN: no My Rides opening, no simulated mouse movement.
-- This is a best-effort executor-dependent way to call the *existing*
-- on-click client handler. It does not invent a RemoteEvent or forge an ID.
-- Success is *only* confirmed when the server creates the G2 ride.
local function silentSpawn(button, methodIndex)
    if not button or not button:IsA("GuiButton") then
        return false, "G2 Spawn button not found"
    end

    local methods = {
        {"Activated", "connections"},
        {"MouseButton1Click", "connections"},
        {"MouseButton1Down", "connections"},
        {"Activated", "signal"},
        {"MouseButton1Click", "signal"},
        {"MouseButton1Up", "connections"}
    }

    local entry = methods[(methodIndex - 1) % #methods + 1]
    local eventName, action = entry[1], entry[2]
    local signal = button[eventName]

    if action == "signal" then
        if type(firesignal) ~= "function" then
            return false, "firesignal is unavailable in Medium"
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(firesignal, signal)
        if not ok then
            return false, eventName .. ": " .. tostring(err)
        end
        return true, "firesignal(" .. eventName .. ")"
    end

    if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then
        return false, "getconnections is unavailable in Medium"
    end

    local okConnections, results = pcall(getconnections, signal)
    if not okConnections then
        return false, "getconnections(" .. eventName .. ") failed: " .. tostring(results)
    end

    if type(results) ~= "table" or #results == 0 then
        return false, "No visible " .. eventName .. " callbacks"
    end

    -- One callback at a time so we do not double-spawn/toggle the scooter.
    -- These are executor APIs, not Roblox's supported scripting APIs.
    for _, conn in ipairs(results) do
        local okProps, active, fn, fire = pcall(function()
            return conn.Enabled, conn.Function, conn.Fire
        end)
        if okProps and active ~= false then
            if type(fn) == "function" then
                local ok, err
                if eventName == "Activated" then
                    ok, err = pcall(fn, nil, 1)
                else
                    ok, err = pcall(fn)
                end
                if ok then
                    return true, "callback(" .. eventName .. ")"
                end
                return false, "callback " .. eventName .. " failed: " .. tostring(err)
            elseif type(fire) == "function" then
                local ok, err = pcall(fire, conn)
                if ok then
                    return true, "connection.Fire(" .. eventName .. ")"
                end
                return false, "connection.Fire failed: " .. tostring(err)
            end
        end
    end
    return false, "No callable " .. eventName .. " listener"
end

local function recoveryFailure(message)
    -- A failed attempt must NOT turn AUTO OFF.
    -- Retry with a cooldown, so an obscured UI does not get spam-clicked.
    if recoveryPrompt then
        pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
    end
    recoveryPrompt = nil
    recoveryFailures += 1
    recoveryRetryAt = os.clock() + math.min(15, 3 + recoveryFailures * 2)
    recoveryActive = false
    recoveryElapsed = 0
    recoveryCooldown = 0
    travelAttempts = 0
    returnAttempts = 0
    spawnAttempts = 0
    recoveryReturned = false
    stageGroundY = nil
    stagePhase = "none"
    stageElapsed = 0
    stageFinalStable = 0
    stageAttempts = 0
    status.Text = "RECOVERY RETRY"
    warn("[AUTO RECOVERY] " .. tostring(message)
        .. " | attempt " .. recoveryFailures
        .. " | retry pending; AUTO stays ON")
end

local function moveCharacterTo(destination)
    local character = player.Character
    local transform = destination * root.CFrame:Inverse()
    character:PivotTo(transform * character:GetPivot())
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- Ground-aware recovery: use the actual lowest collidable scooter part,
-- not the character's original Y. This prevents the wheels from being
-- placed through the ground when the G2 is spawned elsewhere.
local FINAL_GROUND_CLEARANCE = 0.55
local INITIAL_CLEARANCE = 1.25  -- one safe placement; gravity handles descent
local SETTLE_OBSERVE = 0.30
local SETTLE_LIMIT = 1.8
local MIN_RIDE_PARTS = 15

local function getRideBottom(ride)
    local lowest = math.huge
    local collidable = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(ride:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
            local frame, size = p.CFrame, p.Size
            local halfVertical = (
                math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X
                + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y
                + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z
            ) * 0.5
            lowest = math.min(lowest, p.Position.Y - halfVertical)
            collidable += 1
        end
    end
    if collidable == 0 then
        -- Some vehicle games turn all collisions off temporarily.
        -- In that case use the model bounds only as a fallback.
        local frame, size = ride:GetBoundingBox()
        local halfVertical = (
            math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X
            + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y
            + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z
        ) * 0.5
        lowest = frame.Position.Y - halfVertical
    end
    return lowest
end

local function raycastFloorAt(worldPos, ride)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ride, player.Character}
    params.RespectCanCollide = true
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local highest = nil
    -- Nearby samples help avoid sinking on slightly uneven terrain.
    for _, offset in ipairs({
        Vector3.zero,
        Vector3.new(1.2, 0, 0),
        Vector3.new(-1.2, 0, 0),
        Vector3.new(0, 0, 1.2),
        Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.2)
    }) do
        local origin = worldPos + offset + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -140, 0), params)
        if hit and (not highest or hit.Position.Y > highest) then
            highest = hit.Position.Y
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function moveRideAndRider(ride, delta)
    if delta.Magnitude < 0.001 then return end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not root or not root.Parent then return end
    local beforeRoot = root.Position
    local beforeCharacterPivot = character:GetPivot()
    -- A welded rider may move together with the ride. Reposition the
    -- character only by the REMAINING displacement to avoid double-moving.
    ride:PivotTo(CFrame.new(delta) * ride:GetPivot())
    local remaining = beforeRoot + delta - root.Position
    if remaining.Magnitude > 0.03 then
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(remaining) * character:GetPivot())
    end
    -- Keep landing gradual and prevent old fall/spin velocity carrying over.
    local currentSeat = ownRideSeat()
    if currentSeat then
        currentSeat.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        currentSeat.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

local function returnRideHome(seat)
    local ride = childPath(workspace, {"Rides", "Ride_" .. player.Name})
    if not ride or not ride:IsA("Model") then
        return false, "Own ride model is unavailable"
    end
    if humanoid.SeatPart ~= seat or not homeCFrame then
        return false, "Mounting must be confirmed before returning"
    end
    local count = 0
    for _, item in ipairs(ride:GetDescendants()) do
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then count += 1 end
    end
    if count < MIN_RIDE_PARTS then
        return false, "G2 model has not finished loading"
    end
    local home = homeCFrame.Position
    local floorY = raycastFloorAt(home, ride)
    if not floorY then
        return false, "Could not locate solid ground at saved position"
    end
    local ok, message = pcall(function()
        local bottomY = getRideBottom(ride)
        local desiredBottomY = floorY + FINAL_GROUND_CLEARANCE + INITIAL_CLEARANCE
        local delta = Vector3.new(
            home.X - root.Position.X,
            desiredBottomY - bottomY,
            home.Z - root.Position.Z
        )
        moveRideAndRider(ride, delta)
    end)
    if ok then
        print(string.format(
            "[G2 V10] One-time placement, bottom %.2f studs above floor. Letting physics settle.",
            INITIAL_CLEARANCE + FINAL_GROUND_CLEARANCE
        ))
    end
    return ok, message, floorY
end

local function recoverRide(dt)
    local candidateSeat = ownRideSeat()
    local candidatePrompt = candidateSeat
        and candidateSeat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    local seatIsG2 = isG2Prompt(candidatePrompt)
    -- G4 Pro may already exist: only a confirmed G2 counts as ready.
    local seat = seatIsG2 and candidateSeat or nil
    local mounted = seat and humanoid.SeatPart == seat
    if seatIsG2 and not recoveryG2Seen then
        print("[G2 DETECT] Own G2 found; EnterPrompt=" .. tostring(candidatePrompt.ObjectText))
        recoveryG2Seen = true
        -- Remember which silent input method worked for the next start.
        if environment and lastInvokedSpawnMethod then
            environment.SpinStudioG2PreferredMethod = lastInvokedSpawnMethod
            print("[G2 V10] Cached successful spawn method:", lastInvokedSpawnMethod)
        end
    elseif not seatIsG2 then
        recoveryG2Seen = false
    end
    if mounted and not recoveryMountedSeen then
        print("[G2 AUTO] G2 SEAT CONFIRMED")
        recoveryMountedSeen = true
    elseif not mounted then
        recoveryMountedSeen = false
    end

    -- A disconnected SeatPart means the rider is no longer actually seated.
    -- Remove the local retention weld BEFORE attempting to travel/reattach.
    if not mounted and releaseRiderLock then
        releaseRiderLock()
    end

    -- Manual-spawn mode: once the player is actually seated on their G2,
    -- spin must not wait for the automated spawn/recovery sequence.
    -- In particular, phase may still be "recovery" after a manual mount.
    if mounted and not autoSpawn then
        if recoveryActive then
            cancelRecovery()
        end
        recoveryFailures = 0
        recoveryRetryAt = 0
        if phase == "recovery" or phase == "off" then
            fixedX = root.Position.X
            fixedZ = root.Position.Z
            startCycle()
            print("[G2 V10 MANUAL] Manual G2 mount confirmed. Spinning started.")
        end
        return false
    end

    if mounted and not recoveryActive then
        recoveryFailures = 0
        recoveryRetryAt = 0
        return false
    end

    if not mounted and os.clock() < recoveryRetryAt then
        status.Text = "RECOVERY RETRY"
        return true
    end

    if not recoveryActive then
        recoveryActive = true
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        recoveryStable = 0
        recoveryCooldown = 0
        spawnAttempts = 0
        uiClickAttempts = 0
        recoveryTravelled = false
        recoveryReturned = false
        stageGroundY = nil
        stagePhase = "none"
        stageElapsed = 0
        stageFinalStable = 0
        stageAttempts = 0
        travelAttempts = 0
        returnAttempts = 0
        phase = "recovery"
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0
        )
        local angle = heading()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
    end

    recoveryCooldown = math.max(0, recoveryCooldown - dt)
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    if mounted then
        if recoveryPrompt then
            pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
            recoveryPrompt = nil
        end

        -- Initial spawn or post-fall: ONE ground-aware placement only.
        -- Unlike V9, do not force hover height every physics frame.
        if not recoveryReturned then
            if recoveryCooldown > 0 then return true end
            if returnAttempts >= 3 then
                recoveryFailure("Could not place G2 safely")
                return true
            end
            status.Text = "POSITIONING G2"
            local ok, message, floorY = returnRideHome(seat)
            if not ok then
                returnAttempts += 1
                recoveryCooldown = 0.25
                if returnAttempts >= 3 then
                    recoveryFailure(message)
                end
                return true
            end
            returnAttempts += 1
            recoveryReturned = true
            stageGroundY = floorY
            stagePhase = "settle"
            stageElapsed = 0
            stageFinalStable = 0
            recoveryCooldown = 0.10
            print("[G2 V10] Placement complete. No repeated hover/landing teleports.")
            return true
        end

        if recoveryCooldown > 0 then return true end
        local ride = childPath(workspace, {"Rides", "Ride_" .. player.Name})
        if not ride or not seat:IsDescendantOf(ride) then
            recoveryFailure("Own G2 disappeared during seat check")
            return true
        end

        stageElapsed += dt
        status.Text = "CHECKING SEAT"
        local stillMounted = humanoid.SeatPart == seat
        local upright = root.CFrame.UpVector.Y >= 0.55
        -- Only observe clearance; never repeatedly move the ride to chase it.
        local floorGap = getRideBottom(ride) - stageGroundY
        local noGroundPenetration = floorGap >= -0.55

        if stillMounted and upright and noGroundPenetration then
            stageFinalStable += dt
        else
            stageFinalStable = 0
        end

        if stageFinalStable >= SETTLE_OBSERVE then
            fixedX = root.Position.X
            fixedZ = root.Position.Z
            cancelRecovery()
            recoveryFailures = 0
            recoveryRetryAt = 0
            notify("RIDE CONFIRMED")
            print("[G2 V10] Seat confirmed, AUTO SPIN STARTED")
            startCycle()  -- Critical: no second AUTO press required.
            return true
        end

        if stageElapsed > SETTLE_LIMIT then
            if stillMounted and noGroundPenetration and upright then
                -- Valid seat but small physics vibration: don't deadlock here.
                warn("[G2 V10] Settle timeout; seat valid. Starting spin.")
                fixedX = root.Position.X
                fixedZ = root.Position.Z
                cancelRecovery()
                recoveryFailures = 0
                recoveryRetryAt = 0
                startCycle()
            else
                -- Avoid a perpetual PivotTo loop if the server disagrees.
                recoveryFailure(string.format(
                    "Safe mount unconfirmed (mounted=%s, upright=%s, floorGap=%.2f)",
                    tostring(stillMounted), tostring(upright), floorGap
                ))
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    recoveryStable = 0

    if not autoEquip and recoveryPrompt then
        pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
        recoveryPrompt = nil
    end

    -- שתי האפשרויות כבויות: מחכה לעלייה ידנית
    if not autoSpawn and not autoEquip then
        status.Text = "MOUNT RIDE TO CONTINUE"
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        return true
    end

    -- זימון בלבד אינו מפעיל E
    if seat and not autoEquip then
        status.Text = "RIDE READY - PRESS E"
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        return true
    end

    if not seat and not autoSpawn then
        status.Text = "NO LOADED RIDE - SPAWN IT"
        recoveryElapsed = 0
        return true
    end

    recoveryElapsed = recoveryElapsed + dt
    if recoveryElapsed > 30 then
        recoveryFailure("Could not confirm recovery within 30 seconds")
        return true
    end

    if recoveryPrompt then
        recoveryHold = recoveryHold - dt
        if not recoveryPrompt.Parent or recoveryHold <= 0 then
            pcall(function() recoveryPrompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
            recoveryPrompt = nil
            recoveryCooldown = 1
        end
        return true
    end
    if recoveryCooldown > 0 then return true end

    local prompt = seat and seat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    if autoEquip and isG2Prompt(prompt) then
        if not prompt.Enabled then
            status.Text = "WAITING FOR ENTER"
            return true
        end

        local allowedRange = math.min(10, prompt.MaxActivationDistance)
        if allowedRange <= 0 then
            recoveryFailure("Enter prompt has no usable activation range")
            return true
        end
        local distance = (seat.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        if distance > allowedRange then
            if travelAttempts >= 3 then
                recoveryFailure("Could not reach the loaded scooter")
                return true
            end
            status.Text = "GOING TO SCOOTER"
            local offset = math.min(3, allowedRange * 0.5)
            local target = seat.Position + seat.CFrame.RightVector * offset
            target = target + Vector3.new(0, math.min(1, allowedRange * 0.2), 0)
            local ok, message = pcall(function()
                moveCharacterTo(CFrame.new(target) * CFrame.Angles(0, heading(), 0))
            end)
            if not ok then recoveryFailure(message); return true end
            travelAttempts = travelAttempts + 1
            recoveryTravelled = true
            recoveryReturned = false
            recoveryCooldown = 0.5
            return true
        end

        status.Text = "ENTERING G2"
        recoveryPrompt = prompt
        recoveryHold = prompt.HoldDuration + 0.15
        recoveryTravelled = true
        recoveryReturned = false
        local ok, message = pcall(function()
            if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                print("[G2 AUTO] EnterPrompt triggered; waiting for actual seating")
                recoveryHold = 0.2
            else
                prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                print("[G2 AUTO] EnterPrompt hold started; waiting for seating")
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            recoveryPrompt = nil
            recoveryFailure("Enter prompt could not be activated: " .. tostring(message))
        end
        return true
    end

    if seat then
        status.Text = "WAITING FOR G2 ENTER"
        return true
    end
    if not autoSpawn then return true end

    -- מוצא את כרטיס G2 לפי הכותרת המוצגת, בלי לנחש שם פנימי
    local rideList = childPath(playerGui, {
        "MainUi", "Rides", "Frame", "CanvasGroup", "ScrollingFrame"
    })
    local spawnButton
    if rideList then
        local g2 = rideList:FindFirstChild("ScooterG2")
        local knownSpawn = g2 and g2:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
        if knownSpawn and knownSpawn:IsA("GuiButton") then
            spawnButton = knownSpawn
        end
    end
    if rideList and not spawnButton then
        for _, item in ipairs(rideList:GetDescendants()) do
            if (item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton"))
                and (item.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") == "G2"
                    or item.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") == "Kuki G2") then
                local card = item.Parent
                while card and card ~= rideList do
                    local candidate = card:FindFirstChild("Spawn", true)
                    if candidate and candidate:IsA("GuiButton") then
                        spawnButton = candidate
                        break
                    end
                    card = card.Parent
                end
                if spawnButton then break end
            end
        end
    end
    -- No opening My Rides. The user may open it manually if the game
    -- requires the panel to be active, but we NEVER click or show it.
    if not spawnButton then
        status.Text = "G2 SPAWN BUTTON NOT FOUND"
        recoveryCooldown = 1
        return true
    end

    if spawnAttempts >= 6 then
        recoveryFailure("Silent spawn methods exhausted without a confirmed G2. "
            .. "See [G2 SILENT] lines; server/UI restrictions may apply.")
        return true
    end

    if os.clock() - uiLastClick < 0.90 then
        return true
    end

    local preferred = environment and environment.SpinStudioG2PreferredMethod
    local order = {}
    if type(preferred) == "number" and preferred >= 1 and preferred <= 6 then
        table.insert(order, preferred)
    end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        if i ~= preferred then table.insert(order, i) end
    end

    -- If an executor method isn't supported, immediately try the next.
    -- After any actual callback returns successfully, wait for the server
    -- to create the G2 before attempting another method.
    while spawnAttempts < 6 do
        local index = order[spawnAttempts + 1]
        spawnAttempts += 1
        local ok, message = silentSpawn(spawnButton, index)
        if ok then
            lastInvokedSpawnMethod = index
            uiLastClick = os.clock()
            recoveryCooldown = 0.90
            status.Text = "VERIFYING G2 SPAWN"
            print(string.format(
                "[G2 SILENT] Method %d/6 called: %s; waiting for G2",
                index, message
            ))
            return true
        end
        warn(string.format(
            "[G2 SILENT] Method %d unavailable: %s (immediate fallback)",
            index, message
        ))
    end

    recoveryFailure("No silent G2 spawn method is available")
    return true
end

-- RIDER LOCK: preserve the rider's attachment to the scooter seat.
-- No anchoring; no changes to spinning speed or existing Anti-Break corrections.
-- A local WeldConstraint may be overridden by the game/server; it is not
-- a guarantee of server-side seating or replication.
local riderLock = {
    seat = nil,
    humanoid = nil,
    character = nil,
    weld = nil,
    jumpAllowed = nil
}

releaseRiderLock = function()
    if riderLock.weld then
        pcall(function() riderLock.weld:Destroy() end)
    end
    if riderLock.humanoid and riderLock.humanoid.Parent then
        pcall(function()
            if riderLock.jumpAllowed ~= nil then
                riderLock.humanoid:SetStateEnabled(
                    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, riderLock.jumpAllowed
                )
            end
        end)
    end
    riderLock.seat = nil
    riderLock.humanoid = nil
    riderLock.character = nil
    riderLock.weld = nil
    riderLock.jumpAllowed = nil
end

maintainRiderLock = function()
    if not enabled then return end
    local char = player.Character
    local human = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not human or not hrp or human.Health <= 0 then
        releaseRiderLock()
        return
    end

    if riderLock.character and riderLock.character ~= char then
        releaseRiderLock()
    end

    -- Never retain a stale weld after dismount. The recovery routine
    -- needs to move the character independently of the scooter.
    if riderLock.seat and human.SeatPart ~= riderLock.seat then
        releaseRiderLock()
    end

    -- Only attach after the player is actually sitting on their own scooter.
    if not riderLock.seat then
        local currentSeat = human.SeatPart
        local ownSeat = ownRideSeat()
        if not currentSeat or currentSeat ~= ownSeat then return end
        local enter = currentSeat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
        if not isG2Prompt(enter) then return end

        riderLock.character = char
        riderLock.humanoid = human
        riderLock.seat = currentSeat
        riderLock.jumpAllowed = human:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Name = "SpinStudio_RiderLock_Local"
        weld.Part0 = currentSeat
        weld.Part1 = hrp
        weld.Parent = hrp
        riderLock.weld = weld
        human:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
        print("[SPIN+LOCK] Rider retention ON")
    end

    if riderLock.weld and not riderLock.weld.Parent then
        -- The game may remove a local constraint; don't silently claim success.
        riderLock.weld = nil
        warn("[SPIN+LOCK] Rider weld removed; cannot guarantee retention")
    end
    if human.SeatPart == riderLock.seat then
        human.Jump = false
    end
end

-- ANTI-BREAK V1: relative assembly correction (no Anchored).
-- Automatically tracks the player's scooter and restarts if it changes.
local LOCK_INTERVAL = 1 / 30
local LOCK_THRESHOLD = 3
local LOCK_MAX_GROUPS = 6
local lockState = {
    scooter = nil, seat = nil, groups = {},
    corrections = 0, peakError = 0, accumulator = 0
}

local function clearLock()
    lockState.scooter = nil
    lockState.seat = nil
    lockState.groups = {}
    lockState.accumulator = 0
end

local function frontPart(part, vehicle)
    local node = part
    while node and node ~= vehicle do
        if node.Name == "SuspensionFixed"
            or node.Name == "SuspensionGeometry"
            or node.Name == "HandGoals" then
            return true
        end
        node = node.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function startLock()
    local char = player.Character
    local human = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local currentSeat = human and human.SeatPart
    local rides = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rides")

    if not currentSeat or not rides or currentSeat ~= ownRideSeat() then return end
    local enter = currentSeat:FindFirstChild("EnterPrompt")
    if not isG2Prompt(enter) then return end

    local vehicle = currentSeat
    while vehicle and vehicle.Parent ~= rides do
        vehicle = vehicle.Parent
    end
    if not vehicle or vehicle.Parent ~= rides then return end

    if lockState.seat == currentSeat
        and lockState.scooter == vehicle then return end

    clearLock()
    lockState.seat = currentSeat
    lockState.scooter = vehicle

    local seatRoot = currentSeat.AssemblyRootPart
    local seen = {}
    for _, part in ipairs(vehicle:GetDescendants()) do
        if #lockState.groups >= LOCK_MAX_GROUPS then break end
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and frontPart(part, vehicle) then
            local assemblyRoot = part.AssemblyRootPart
            if assemblyRoot and assemblyRoot ~= seatRoot
                and assemblyRoot:IsDescendantOf(vehicle)
                and not seen[assemblyRoot] then
                seen[assemblyRoot] = true
                table.insert(lockState.groups, {
                    root = assemblyRoot,
                    offset = currentSeat.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(assemblyRoot.CFrame)
                })
            end
        end
    end
    print(string.format("[SPIN+LOCK] Saved %d assemblies", #lockState.groups))
end

-- Separate update loop: keeps the exact V1 correction policy.
table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not alive or not enabled then return end
    -- Avoid rider weld / anti-break CFrame corrections while moving a newly
    -- spawned G2 into position. This removes the main V9 feedback loop.
    if recoveryActive or phase == "recovery" then
        clearLock()
        return
    end
    maintainRiderLock()
    if not lockState.seat
        or not lockState.seat:IsDescendantOf(lockState.scooter)
        or not player.Character
        or not player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        or (player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").SeatPart ~= lockState.seat
            and riderLock.seat ~= lockState.seat) then
        clearLock()
        startLock()
    end

    local currentSeat = lockState.seat
    local vehicle = lockState.scooter
    if not currentSeat or not vehicle then return end
    lockState.accumulator += dt
    if lockState.accumulator < LOCK_INTERVAL then return end
    lockState.accumulator = 0

    local seatRoot = currentSeat.AssemblyRootPart
    for _, group in ipairs(lockState.groups) do
        local assemblyRoot = group.root
        if assemblyRoot:IsDescendantOf(vehicle)
            and not assemblyRoot.Anchored
            and assemblyRoot.AssemblyRootPart == assemblyRoot
            and assemblyRoot ~= seatRoot then
            local target = currentSeat.CFrame * group.offset
            local errorDistance = (assemblyRoot.Position - target.Position).Magnitude
            lockState.peakError = math.max(lockState.peakError, errorDistance)
            if errorDistance > LOCK_THRESHOLD then
                assemblyRoot.CFrame = target
                lockState.corrections += 1
            end
        end
    end
end))

button.Activated:Connect(function(input)
    local pointerClick = not input
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

end)

table.insert(connections, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
    if not enabled then return end

    if not root or not humanoid then
        connectCharacter()
        return
    end

    if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent
        or humanoid.Health <= 0
        or root.Parent ~= player.Character then

        releaseCharacter()
        status.Text = "WAITING FOR CHARACTER"
        return
    end

    if recoverRide(dt) then
        if releaseStability then releaseStability() end
        return
    end

    if maintainStability then maintainStability(dt) end
    elapsed = elapsed + dt
    local verticalVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    holdUpright(dt)

    if phase == "up" then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        if math.abs(root.Position.Y - targetHeight) < 0.3 then
            turned = 0
            previousAngle = heading()
            setPhase("spin", "SPINNING")
        elseif elapsed > 5 then
            beginLanding()
        end

    elseif phase == "spin" then
        local angle = heading()
        local difference = angle - previousAngle
        local delta = math.atan2(
            math.sin(difference),
            math.cos(difference)
        )

        turned = turned + math.deg(delta)
        previousAngle = angle
        local remaining = targetDegrees - turned

        status.Text = string.format(
            "%.0f / %d", turned, targetDegrees
        )

        if math.abs(turned) >= 60 then guard.sawSpin = true end
        if remaining <= 0.1 then
            guard.completed += 1
            guard.lastCompletedAt = os.clock()
            guard.failedInRow = 0
            guard.sawSpin = false
            beginLanding()
            return
        end
        if (elapsed >= 4 and not guard.sawSpin) or elapsed > 15 then
            flagSpinFailure(elapsed > 15 and "15s spin timeout" or "no measured yaw after 4s")
            return
        end

        local stepTime = math.max(dt, 1 / 240)
        local speed = math.min(
            maxSpeed,
            remaining * finishResponse,
            remaining / stepTime,
            90 / stepTime
        )

        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(
            0, math.rad(speed), 0
        )

    elseif phase == "down" then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        -- With turbo descent, touchdown can happen in 1-2 physics steps.
        -- The old 0.15-second settle detection slowed every loop considerably.
        if root.Position.Y <= baseHeight + 0.24 then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            setPhase("wait", "NEXT ROUND")
        else
            if verticalVelocity < -2 then
                descentObserved = true
            end
            -- Backup: ground collision may stop us a little above baseHeight.
            if math.abs(verticalVelocity) < 1
                and (descentObserved or elapsed >= 0.06) then
                stableTime = stableTime + dt
            else
                stableTime = 0
            end

            if stableTime >= 0.03 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                setPhase("wait", "NEXT ROUND")
            elseif elapsed > 3 then
                setPhase("wait", "RETRYING")
            end
        end

    elseif phase == "wait" then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        if elapsed >= waitTime then
            startCycle()
        end
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
    releaseRiderLock()
    releaseCharacter()

    if enabled then
        status.Text = "WAITING FOR CHARACTER"
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, player.Idled:Connect(function(seconds)
    if not enabled or guard.idle then return end
    guard.idle = true
    warn(string.format("[KL GUARD] Roblox idle for %.0f seconds; idle disconnect may stop long sessions.", seconds))
    notify("ROBLOX IDLE WARNING")
end))

-- V6: loading the script only builds the GUI. No spawn, equip or spinning yet.
-- Only a real press on the original AUTO button switches `enabled` to true.
print("[SPIN STUDIO V10] READY / AUTO OFF")
print("[SPIN STUDIO V10] Press AUTO to auto-spawn G2, auto-mount, and spin.")

gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    alive = false
    toastVersion = toastVersion + 1
    stop()
    clearLock()
    print("[SPIN+LOCK] Corrections:", lockState.corrections,
        "Peak error:", lockState.peakError)
    rainbowTween:Cancel()
    surfaceTween:Cancel()
    toastRGBTween:Cancel()

    if toastTween then toastTween:Cancel() end

    for _, tween in ipairs(effectTweens) do
        tween:Cancel()
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
end)

local function hasWeaponTool(player, weapon)
    for _, container in ipairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
                    if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                            or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function hasEquippedWeapon(weapon)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                    or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                return true
            end
            if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
    local data = playerData[player.Name]
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Knife") then return "Murderer", data end
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Gun") then return "Sheriff", data end
    if type(data) == "table" and data.Dead ~= true and type(data.Role) == "string" then return data.Role, data end
    return nil, data
end
local function getRoundIntel()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local intel = { Murderer = {}, Sheriff = {}, Innocent = {}, }
    local alive = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local role, data = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        local isAlive = type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then isAlive = false end
        if role == "Hero" then role = "Sheriff" end
        if isAlive then
            alive += 1
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Innocent" then
                table.insert(intel[role], player.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    return intel, alive
end
local function isPlaying()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local localData = playerData[LocalPlayer.Name]
    if type(localData) == "table" and localData.Dead == true then return false end
    if hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Gun") or hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Knife") then return true end
    if type(localData) == "table" then
        local role = localData.Role
        if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent" then return true end
    end
    local aliveAttribute = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive")
    if aliveAttribute ~= nil then return aliveAttribute == true end
    return humanoid.Health > 0
end

    if instance:IsA("Tool") then return instance:FindFirstChild("Handle") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end

local function hasClearShot(origin, targetPart)
    if not origin or not targetPart then return false end
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.1 then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = getIgnoredParts()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    if not ok then return false end
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

-- Gun
local function getGunTarget(allowWalls)
    local murderer = findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if not murderer or not playerIsAlive(murderer, playerData) or not murderer.Character then return nil, nil, nil end
    local character = murderer.Character
    local preferred
    if State.GunAimTargetPart == "Torso" then
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Head"), }
    else
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), }
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position or (root and root.Position)
    local targetPart
    for _, part in ipairs(preferred) do
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if allowWalls or not origin or hasClearShot(origin, part) then
                targetPart = part
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not targetPart then return nil, murderer, nil end
    local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 120 end
    local distance = root and (targetPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local leadTime = math.clamp(0.035 + distance / 2200, 0.035, 0.09)
    local predicted = targetPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(predicted), murderer, targetPart
end
local KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
local KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0

-- Knife
local function getKnifeTarget(requireVisible)
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local aimPoint = getCrosshair()
    if not root or not camera or not aimPoint then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local viewOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local now = os.clock()
    local fov = math.max(40, tonumber(State.KnifeAimFOV) or 220)
    local function evaluate(player, sticky)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not playerIsAlive(player, playerData) or not player.Character then return nil end
        local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        if role == "Murderer" then return nil end
        local part = getCharacterKnifeAimPart( player.Character, State.KnifeAimTargetPart )
        if not part then return nil end
        local screenPosition, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - aimPoint).Magnitude
        local allowedFov = sticky and (fov * 1.25) or fov
        if screenDistance > allowedFov then return nil end
        if requireVisible and not hasClearShot(viewOrigin, part) then return nil end
        local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        return part, screenDistance + distance * 0.025, distance
    end
    if KnifeAimStickyPlayer and now <= KnifeAimStickyUntil then
        local part, _, distance = evaluate(KnifeAimStickyPlayer, true)
        if part then
            local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
            local leadTime = math.clamp(distance / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
            return CFrame.new(part.Position + velocity * leadTime), KnifeAimStickyPlayer, part
        end
    end
    local bestTarget
    local bestPart
    local bestDistance
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local part, score, distance = evaluate(player, false)
        if part and score < bestScore then
            bestTarget = player
            bestPart = part
            bestDistance = distance
            bestScore = score
        end
    end
    if not bestTarget or not bestPart then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    KnifeAimStickyPlayer = bestTarget
    KnifeAimStickyUntil = now + 0.28
    local velocity = bestPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
    local leadTime = math.clamp((bestDistance or 0) / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
    local targetPosition = bestPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(targetPosition), bestTarget, bestPart
end

local function isWeaponRay(origin, direction)
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return false end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude < 297 or magnitude > 303 then return false end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end
    if (origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 3.5 then return false end
    if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then
        local ok, caller = pcall(getcallingscript)
        if ok and typeof(caller) == "Instance" then
            local path = string.lower(caller:GetFullName())
            if string.find(path, "camera", 1, true) or string.find(path, "zoom", 1, true) or string.find(path, "occlusion", 1, true) then
                return false
            end
            if string.find(path, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(path, "weapon", 1, true) or string.find(path, "shoot", 1, true)
                or string.find(path, "knife", 1, true) or string.find(path, "projectile", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function raycastToTarget(targetPart)
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then return nil end
    local targetCharacter = targetPart.Parent
    local targetPosition = targetPart.Position
    local ignored = getIgnoredParts()
    for _, child in ipairs(targetCharacter:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(ignored, child)
        end
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local right = targetPart.CFrame.RightVector
    local forward = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
    local offsets = { -forward * 5, forward * 5, right * 5, -right * 5, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), }
    for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
        local origin = targetPosition + offset
        local direction = targetPosition - origin
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local ok, result = pcall(raycastForGunAimV2, origin, direction, params )
            if ok and result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter) then return result end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Shot redirection
local function isGunShotRemote(instance)
    if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not (instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then return false end
    local lowerName = string.lower(instance.Name)
    local lowerPath = string.lower(instance:GetFullName())
    if not (string.find(lowerName, "shoot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "shot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "fire", 1, true)
        or string.find(lowerName, "hit", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "shootgun", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "knifeserver", 1, true)) then
        return false
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local ancestor = instance.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= game do
        if ancestor:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(ancestor.Name)
            local isGun = ancestor:FindFirstChild("IsGun") ~= nil or CollectionService:HasTag(ancestor, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun"
            return isGun and ancestor.Parent == character
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return getEquippedGunTool() ~= nil
end

        local targetCFrame, _, targetPart = getGunTarget(State.GunRageMode == true)

        return nil, nil
    end
    if premiumGunAimIsEnabled() then
        local targetCFrame, _, targetPart = getPremiumGunAimCFrame()
        if targetCFrame and targetPart then return targetPart.Position, targetPart end

    end
    return nil, nil
end
local function rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
    local targetPosition, targetPart = getGunRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if State.GunRageMode then
            local spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
            if spoofedOrigin and targetCFrame then
                args[1] = spoofedOrigin
                args[2] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        else
            args[2] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        end
    end
    local function replaceArgument(index)
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[index] = targetPosition
            return true
        elseif valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[index] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Ray" then
            local originalRay = args[index]
            local direction = targetPosition - originalRay.Origin
            if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                args[index] = Ray.new(originalRay.Origin, direction.Unit * math.max(originalRay.Direction.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude) )
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Instance" and args[index] ~= LocalPlayer.Character and targetPart then
            args[index] = targetPart
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and replaceArgument(2) then return true end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        if index ~= 2 and replaceArgument(index) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
    local targetPosition, targetPart = getKnifeRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    local wallBang = State.KnifeRageMode == true
    local spoofedOrigin
    local targetCFrame
    if wallBang then
        spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
    else
        targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local normalOrigin = root and root.Position or targetPosition
    local throwOrigin = wallBang and spoofedOrigin and spoofedOrigin.Position or normalOrigin
    local throwDirection = targetPosition - throwOrigin
    if throwDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        throwDirection = throwDirection.Unit
    else
        throwDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end
    if argumentCount == 1 then
        local valueType = typeof(args[1])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[1] = targetCFrame
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[1] = args[1].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
            return true
        end
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin
        end
        args[2] = targetCFrame
        return true
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin.Position
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin
            else
                args[index] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Vector3" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin.Position
            else
                args[index] = args[index].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function sendWeaponRemote(remote, method, args, argumentCount)
    if method == "FireServer" then
        remote.FireServer(remote, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
        return nil
    end
    return remote.InvokeServer(remote, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
end
local function callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    if method == "Raycast" or method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
        local ok, directMethod = pcall(function()
            return self[method]
        end)
        if ok and type(directMethod) == "function" then return directMethod(self, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount)) end
    end
    return OriginalWorkspaceNamecall(self, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
end

-- Weapon hooks
local function installNamecallHook()
    if OriginalWorkspaceNamecall or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end
    local namecallHook
    namecallHook = function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args = { ... }
        local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isKnifeThrowRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.GunAimV2 or State.GunRageMode or premiumGunAimIsEnabled())
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isGunShotRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if self == workspace and method == "Raycast" and not BypassWeaponAimRedirect and not State.RoundCombatSuspended and isPlaying() then
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") and not State.GunRageMode and (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]) then
                local result = getGunRayHit(args[3])
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
                and ((State.KnifeRageMode and isKnifeWallBangRay(args[1], args[2])) or (not State.KnifeRageMode and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]))) then
                local result = getKnifeRayHit()
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
        return callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    end
    OriginalWorkspaceNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", type(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(namecallHook) or namecallHook )
end

local function installWeaponHook()
    if type(WeaponService) ~= "table" or WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked then return end
    WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = true
    local function redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if State.RoundCombatSuspended then return nil end
        if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return nil end
        if (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and not State.GunRageMode and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") then
            local targetCFrame = getGunTargetCFrame()
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        if (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2)) and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then
            local targetCFrame = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local mouseWrapper
    local targetWrapper
    mouseWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceMouseRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    targetWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceTargetRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
        mouseWrapper = newcclosure(mouseWrapper)
        targetWrapper = newcclosure(targetWrapper)
    end
    local hooked = false
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame) == "function"
        and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition) == "function" then
        local okMouse, rawMouse = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame, mouseWrapper )
        local okTarget, rawTarget = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition, targetWrapper )
        if okMouse and okTarget and type(rawMouse) == "function" and type(rawTarget) == "function" then
            WeaponServiceMouseRaw = rawMouse
            WeaponServiceTargetRaw = rawTarget
            hooked = true
        end
    end
    if not hooked then
        WeaponServiceMouseRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        WeaponServiceTargetRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = mouseWrapper
        WeaponService.GetTargetPosition = targetWrapper
    end
end

-- Round state
local function updateRoundState()
    local ok, intel, alive = pcall(getRoundIntel)
    if ok and intel then
        State.RoundCombatSuspended = not (#intel.Murderer > 0 and alive > 1)
    else
        State.RoundCombatSuspended = true
    end
    if State.RoundCombatSuspended then
        State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
    end
end
updateRoundState()
pcall(installNamecallHook)
pcall(installWeaponHook)
local watchedTools = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function armShot()
    if not State.Running then return end
    if not getEquippedGunTool() and not getEquippedKnifeTool() then return end
    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = os.clock() + 0.05
end
local function watchTool(tool)
    if typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") or watchedTools[tool] then return end
    watchedTools[tool] = true
    track(tool.Activated:Connect(armShot))
end
local function watchCharacter(char)
    for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do watchTool(tool) end
    track(char.ChildAdded:Connect(watchTool))
end
track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if not processed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        armShot()
    end
end))
track(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    State.RoundCombatSuspended = true
    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
    watchCharacter(char)
    task.delay(0.4, updateRoundState)
end))
if LocalPlayer.Character then watchCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character) end
task.spawn(function()
    while State.Running do
        updateRoundState()
        task.wait(0.6)
    end
end)
