scripts.code:
--[[
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	 CONVEYOR AUTO  ·  Anime Card Farm            (NextUI edition)
	 Авторолл конвейера + автопокупка паков по белому списку мутаций.
	 Один файл LocalScript. Запуск через исполнитель (Madium / любой с
	 fireclickdetector).

	 ИНТЕРФЕЙС ПЕРЕПИСАН НА NextUI — https://diser.me/nextui/
	   Вся ручная отрисовка (ScreenGui, твины, скроллы, свои дропдауны,
	   тосты, перетаскивание окна) удалена. Теперь окно, вкладки, карточки,
	   переключатели, слайдеры, дропдауны, мультиселекты, кейбинды,
	   уведомления, поиск по элементам, темы и «стекло» — из библиотеки.
	   Логика (конфиг, скан плота, данные паков, remote, движок) не менялась.
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	ЧТО ДЕЛАЕТ
	  • Крутит кнопку "Spawn Pack" на твоём плоте (клик по ClickDetector).
	  • Читает события ConveyorRE: какой пак выпал и с какой мутацией.
	  • Покупает пак только если ОН включён в списке И его мутация отмечена.
	  • Останавливается при "Not enough money" (опция, по умолчанию включена).
	  • Настройки сохраняются в файл и переживают реджойн.

	ЧЕГО НЕ ДЕЛАЕТ
	  • Не продаёт карты, не качает апгрейды, не трогает другие системы.
	  • Не покупает паки, которые не спавнятся кнопкой (Robux-only исключены).

	ВКЛАДКИ
	  Autoroll  — главный переключатель, интервал ролла, джиттер,
	              живой статус, счётчики, «последний увиденный пак».
	  Packs     — выбранный пак + список мутаций для покупки,
	              массовое включение/выключение, применение мутаций ко всем.
	  Settings  — поведение, горячие клавиши, хранилище, обслуживание.

	ГОРЯЧИЕ КЛАВИШИ
	  RightShift или Insert — показать/скрыть окно (меняется в Settings).
	  R                     — старт/стоп авторолла (кнопка клавиши в строке
	                          Autoroll на вкладке Autoroll).
	  Поиск по всем элементам — строка поиска в шапке окна (клавиша «/»).

	КОНСОЛЬ
	  Все сообщения скрипта помечены префиксом [CA].

	СЕКЦИИ
	  CONFIG → STORE → UTIL → SCANNER → DATA → NET → ENGINE → UI → BOOT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

--============================================================
-- 0. HEADER — служебные константы и сервисы
--============================================================

local SCRIPT_NAME = "ConveyorAuto"
local VERSION = "2.0.0"
local LOG_PREFIX = "[CA]"
local NEXTUI_URL = "https://diser.me/nextui/source.lua"

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	repeat
		task.wait()
	until Players.LocalPlayer
	player = Players.LocalPlayer
end

--============================================================
-- 1. CONFIG — дефолтные настройки (UI сохраняет значения поверх)
--============================================================

local CONFIG = {
	version = 2,

	-- Интервал между прокрутками в миллисекундах.
	-- Сервер держит CanPress=false ~650 мс, поэтому ниже 700 смысла нет.
	timingMs = 800,
	minTimingMs = 700,
	maxTimingMs = 60000,
	-- Случайная добавка к интервалу (0..jitterMs), чтобы не долбить ровно в такт.
	jitterMs = 60,
	maxJitterMs = 600,

	-- Клавиши. Храним именами KeyCode ("R", "RightShift", ...).
	keybinds = {
		toggleUI = "RightShift",
		toggleRoll = "R",
	},

	options = {
		-- Останавливать авторолл, когда сервер вернул NotEnoughMoney.
		stopOnNoMoney = true,
		-- Запускать авторолл сразу при загрузке скрипта.
		autoStart = false,
		-- Показывать оверлей со списком горячих клавиш NextUI.
		showBindList = false,
	},

	-- Где хранить настройки: "auto" (файл, если доступен, иначе атрибуты),
	-- "file" (только файл), "attributes" (только атрибуты внутри игры).
	storage = "auto",
	storageFolder = "AnimeCardFarm",
	storageFile = "ConveyorAuto.json",

	-- Порядок мутаций в списках: редчайшие сверху.
	-- Первые четыре зафиксированы вручную (у них Weight = 0),
	-- остальные сортируются по Weight по возрастанию автоматически.
	-- Значения — «сырые» имена мутаций из модуля игры.
	mutationOrder = { "Nightmare", "Unknow", "Nullstar", "Admin" },

	--═══ ПОЛНАЯ КАСТОМИЗАЦИЯ ПОКУПОК ═══
	-- Ключ — Id пака из ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ConveyorPacks.
	-- enabled = true  → скрипт вообще рассматривает этот пак.
	-- mutations[имя] = true → покупать только с этой мутацией.
	-- Пустой mutations = пак включён, но не покупается (нет разрешённых мутаций).
	packs = {
		-- Пример (раскомментируй и поправь под себя):
		-- ["Ice Pack"] = {
		-- 	enabled = true,
		-- 	mutations = { Normal = true, Golden = true },
		-- },
	},
	-- Служебный флаг: true, когда паки уже настраивались в UI/сохранены.
	packsConfigured = false,
}

--============================================================
-- 2. STORE — сохранение/загрузка конфига (JSON-файл или атрибуты)
--============================================================

local Store = {}
local state = nil
local storageMode = "attributes"
local dataHolder = nil
local saveSeq = 0

local function deepCopy(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(value) do
		copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return copy
end

-- Аккуратно накладывает загруженные значения на дефолты:
-- типы должны совпадать, неизвестные ключи игнорируются.
local function mergeDefaults(base, incoming)
	if type(incoming) ~= "table" then
		return base
	end
	for k, v in pairs(incoming) do
		local current = base[k]
		if type(current) == "table" and type(v) == "table" then
			mergeDefaults(current, v)
		elseif current ~= nil then
			if type(current) == type(v) then
				base[k] = v
			end
		else
			base[k] = deepCopy(v)
		end
	end
	return base
end

local function clampTiming(value)
	local minValue = CONFIG.minTimingMs
	local maxValue = CONFIG.maxTimingMs
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if not n then
		return CONFIG.timingMs
	end
	n = math.floor(n + 0.5)
	if n < minValue then
		n = minValue
	end
	if n > maxValue then
		n = maxValue
	end
	return n
end

local function clampJitter(value)
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if not n then
		return CONFIG.jitterMs
	end
	n = math.floor(n + 0.5)
	if n < 0 then
		n = 0
	end
	if n > CONFIG.maxJitterMs then
		n = CONFIG.maxJitterMs
	end
	return n
end

-- Кейбинды хранятся строкой ("R"), но старые конфиги с таблицей тоже читаем.
local function normalizeKeyName(raw, fallback)
	if type(raw) == "table" then
		raw = raw.key
	end
	if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
		local ok, code = pcall(function()
			return Enum.KeyCode[raw]
		end)
		if ok and code then
			return raw
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

local function normalizeConfig(raw)
	local cfg = deepCopy(CONFIG)
	local savedPacks = nil

	if type(raw) == "table" then
		-- Паки применяем атомарно: если в сохранённом конфиге есть список паков,
		-- он полностью заменяет дефолты из CONFIG (иначе снятые галочки
		-- «возвращались» бы из шапки файла).
		local incoming = deepCopy(raw)
		if type(incoming.packs) == "table" then
			savedPacks = incoming.packs
			incoming.packs = nil
		end
		mergeDefaults(cfg, incoming)
	end

	if savedPacks and cfg.packsConfigured == true then
		cfg.packs = savedPacks
	end

	cfg.timingMs = clampTiming(cfg.timingMs)
	cfg.jitterMs = clampJitter(cfg.jitterMs)
	cfg.keybinds.toggleUI = normalizeKeyName(cfg.keybinds.toggleUI, CONFIG.keybinds.toggleUI)
	cfg.keybinds.toggleRoll = normalizeKeyName(cfg.keybinds.toggleRoll, CONFIG.keybinds.toggleRoll)
	if type(cfg.packs) ~= "table" then
		cfg.packs = {}
	end
	-- Чистим мусорные записи паков, чтобы движок не спотыкался.
	for packId, entry in pairs(cfg.packs) do
		if type(entry) ~= "table" then
			cfg.packs[packId] = nil
		else
			if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
				entry.mutations = {}
			end
			entry.enabled = entry.enabled == true
			for mutName, allowed in pairs(entry.mutations) do
				if allowed ~= true then
					entry.mutations[mutName] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return cfg
end

local function getHolder()
	local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then
		playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
	end
	if not playerGui then
		return nil
	end
	local holder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ConveyorAutoData")
	if not holder then
		holder = Instance.new("Folder")
		holder.Name = "ConveyorAutoData"
		holder.Parent = playerGui
	end
	return holder
end

local function hasFileApi()
	return type(writefile) == "function"
		and type(readfile) == "function"
		and type(isfile) == "function"
		and type(makefolder) == "function"
end

local function folderExists(path)
	if type(isfolder) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(isfolder, path)
		return ok and value == true
	end
	return false
end

local function resolveStorage()
	if CONFIG.storage == "file" then
		storageMode = hasFileApi() and "file" or "attributes"
	elseif CONFIG.storage == "attributes" then
		storageMode = "attributes"
	else
		storageMode = hasFileApi() and "file" or "attributes"
	end
end

local function fullPath()
	return CONFIG.storageFolder .. "/" .. CONFIG.storageFile
end

local function readRaw()
	if storageMode == "file" then
		local ok, contents = pcall(readfile, fullPath())
		if ok and type(contents) == "string" and contents ~= "" then
			return contents, "file"
		end
		return nil, "file"
	end
	if dataHolder then
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return dataHolder:GetAttribute("Config")
		end)
		if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
			return value, "attributes"
		end
	end
	return nil, "attributes"
end

local function writeRaw(payload)
	if storageMode == "file" then
		if not folderExists(CONFIG.storageFolder) then
			pcall(makefolder, CONFIG.storageFolder)
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(writefile, fullPath(), payload)
		if not ok then
			warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN file save failed: " .. tostring(err))
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	if dataHolder then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			dataHolder:SetAttribute("Config", payload)
		end)
		return ok
	end
	return false
end

function Store.init()
	resolveStorage()
	dataHolder = getHolder()

	local raw, source = readRaw()
	local loaded = nil
	if raw then
		local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
		end)
		if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
			loaded = decoded
		else
			warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN config is corrupted, using defaults (" .. source .. ")")
		end
	end

	state = normalizeConfig(loaded)
	Store.save(true)

	if storageMode == "file" then
		print(LOG_PREFIX .. " storage: file → " .. fullPath())
	else
		warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN storage: PlayerGui attributes (settings reset on rejoin)")
	end
	return state
end

function Store.get()
	if not state then
		state = normalizeConfig(nil)
	end
	return state
end

-- Возвращает запись пака, создавая её при необходимости (только для записи).
function Store.packEntry(packId)
	local cfg = Store.get()
	local entry = cfg.packs[packId]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" then
		entry = { enabled = false, mutations = {} }
		cfg.packs[packId] = entry
	end
	if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
		entry.mutations = {}
	end
	cfg.packsConfigured = true
	return entry
end

-- Только чтение: ничего не создаёт (чтобы не засорять конфиг).
function Store.readPack(packId)
	local entry = Store.get().packs[packId]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
		entry.mutations = {}
	end
	return entry
end

function Store.isAllowed(packId, mutation)
	local entry = Store.get().packs[packId]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" or entry.enabled ~= true then
		return false
	end
	if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	return entry.mutations[mutation] == true
end

function Store.save(immediate)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	saveSeq = saveSeq + 1
	local token = saveSeq

	local function doSave()
		local ok, payload = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONEncode(state)
		end)
		if not ok or type(payload) ~= "string" then
			warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN config encode failed")
			return
		end
		writeRaw(payload)
	end

	if immediate then
		doSave()
	else
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if token == saveSeq then
				doSave()
			end
		end)
	end
end

function Store.reset()
	state = normalizeConfig(nil)
	Store.save(true)
end

function Store.setTiming(ms)
	local cfg = Store.get()
	cfg.timingMs = clampTiming(ms)
	Store.save()
	return cfg.timingMs
end

function Store.setJitter(ms)
	local cfg = Store.get()
	cfg.jitterMs = clampJitter(ms)
	Store.save()
	return cfg.jitterMs
end

function Store.isFileMode()
	return storageMode == "file"
end

-- 3. UTIL — логи и мелкие помощники
--============================================================

local connections = {}

local function track(connection)
	connections[#connections + 1] = connection
	return connection
end

local function log(...)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(select(i, ...))
	end
	print(LOG_PREFIX .. " " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
end

local function warnLog(...)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(select(i, ...))
	end
	warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
end

local function safeRequire(module)
	if typeof(module) ~= "Instance" or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	if ok then
		return result
	end
	warnLog("WARN require failed: " .. module:GetFullName() .. " → " .. tostring(result))
	return nil
end

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
	if value < minValue then
		return minValue
	elseif value > maxValue then
		return maxValue
	end
	return value
end

local function round(value)
	return math.floor(value + 0.5)
end

local function formatPrice(value)
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if not n then
		return tostring(value)
	end
	local abs = math.abs(n)
	if abs >= 1e12 then
		return string.format("%.2fT", n / 1e12)
	elseif abs >= 1e9 then
		return string.format("%.2fB", n / 1e9)
	elseif abs >= 1e6 then
		return string.format("%.2fM", n / 1e6)
	elseif abs >= 1e3 then
		return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1e3)
	end
	return tostring(round(n))
end

-- Строка "R" → Enum.KeyCode.R (без падений на кривых конфигах).
local function keyCodeOf(name, fallback)
	local ok, code = pcall(function()
		return Enum.KeyCode[tostring(name)]
	end)
	if ok and typeof(code) == "EnumItem" then
		return code
	end
	return fallback or Enum.KeyCode.R
end

local function getPlotNumber()
	local value = player:FindFirstChild("PlotNumber")
	if value and value:IsA("ValueBase") then

function Scanner.refresh()
	local plotNumber, plotValue = getPlotNumber()
	Scanner.plotNumber = plotNumber
	Scanner.plot = nil
	Scanner.buttonPart = nil
	Scanner.clickDetector = nil
	Scanner.localModels = nil

	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("MAP")
	local plots = map and map:FindFirstChild("Plots")
	if plots and plotNumber ~= nil then
		local plot = plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(plotNumber))
		if plot then
			local plotN0 = plot:FindFirstChild("Plot_N0")
			Scanner.plot = plotN0 or plot
		end
	end

	if Scanner.plot then
		local button = Scanner.plot:FindFirstChild("ButtonPart")
		if not button then
			-- на всякий случай ищем вглубь, но только кнопку с ClickDetector
			for _, descendant in ipairs(Scanner.plot:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant.Name == "ButtonPart" and descendant:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector") then
					button = descendant
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if button then
			Scanner.buttonPart = button
			Scanner.clickDetector = button:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
				or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true)
		end
		Scanner.localModels = Scanner.plot:FindFirstChild("LocalConveyorModels")
	end

	local ok = pcall(function()
		Scanner.mutationDisplay = safeRequire(
			ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
				and ReplicatedStorage.Modules:FindFirstChild("MutationDisplay")
		)
	end)
	if not ok then
		Scanner.mutationDisplay = nil
	end

	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if remotes then
		Scanner.conveyorRE = remotes:FindFirstChild("ConveyorRE")
	end

	local gradients = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("UiGradient")
	if gradients then
		Scanner.mutationGradients = gradients:FindFirstChild("Mutations")
		Scanner.rarityGradients = gradients:FindFirstChild("Rarity")
	end

	if not Scanner.buttonPart or not Scanner.clickDetector then
		warnLog("WARN spawn button not found (plot " .. tostring(plotNumber) .. ") — rolling disabled")
	end
	return Scanner.buttonPart ~= nil and Scanner.clickDetector ~= nil
end

-- Проверяет, что цель жива; при необходимости пере-сканирует.
function Scanner.ensure()
	local button = Scanner.buttonPart
	local detector = Scanner.clickDetector
	if button and button.Parent and detector and detector.Parent then

	return Scanner.refresh()

	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return button:GetAttribute("CanPress")

	if not ok then

	end
	return value

-- Сэмплирует первый ключевой кадр UIGradient по имени (для цвета чипа).
local function gradientColor(folder, name, fallback)
	if not folder then
		return fallback
	end
	local gradient = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not gradient then
		gradient = folder:FindFirstChild(name .. "1")
	end
	if gradient and gradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
		local ok, sequence = pcall(function()
			return gradient.Color
		end)
		if ok and typeof(sequence) == "ColorSequence" then
			local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
			if keypoints and #keypoints > 0 then
				return keypoints[1].Value
			end
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

-- 5. DATA — нормализованные паки и мутации из модуля игры
--============================================================

local Data = {
	packs = {},
	packById = {},
	mutations = {},
	mutationByName = {},
	packsModule = nil,
	ready = false,
}

local FALLBACK_MUTATION_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(180, 190, 210)
local FALLBACK_RARITY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(110, 120, 145)

local function displayMutation(name)
	local display = Scanner.mutationDisplay
	if display and type(display.GetDisplayName) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(display.GetDisplayName, name)
		if ok and type(value) == "string" then
			return value
		end
	end
	if name == "Unknow" then
		return "Unknown"
	end
	return name
end

function Data.build()
	Data.packs = {}
	Data.packById = {}
	Data.mutations = {}
	Data.mutationByName = {}
	Data.ready = false

	local moduleInstance = findPacksModule()
	local module = safeRequire(moduleInstance)
	if not module or type(module.List) ~= "table" then
		warnLog("WARN ConveyorPacks module not available — pack list disabled")
		return false
	end

	Data.packsModule = module
	Scanner.packsModule = module

	local rarityRank = type(module.RarityRank) == "table" and module.RarityRank or {}

	--═══ Паки: Robux-only и «мёртвые» (Weight <= 0) полностью исключены ═══
	for _, pack in ipairs(module.List) do
		local skip = pack.RobuxOnly == true
		if not skip and (tonumber(pack.Weight) or 0) <= 0 then
			skip = true
		end
		if not skip then
			local rank = tonumber(rarityRank[pack.Rarity]) or 99
			local entry = {
				id = tostring(pack.Id),
				rarity = tostring(pack.Rarity or "Unknown"),
				rarityRank = rank,
				price = tonumber(pack.Price) or 0,
				weight = tonumber(pack.Weight) or 0,
				openTime = tonumber(pack.OpenTime) or 0,
				color = gradientColor(Scanner.rarityGradients, tostring(pack.Rarity), FALLBACK_RARITY_COLOR),
			}
			Data.packs[#Data.packs + 1] = entry
			Data.packById[entry.id] = entry
		end
	end

	table.sort(Data.packs, function(a, b)
		if a.rarityRank ~= b.rarityRank then
			return a.rarityRank < b.rarityRank
		end
		return a.id < b.id
	end)

	--═══ Мутации: сначала ручной порядок, затем по Weight (редчайшие сверху) ═══
	local orderIndex = {}
	for index, name in ipairs(CONFIG.mutationOrder) do
		orderIndex[name] = index
	end

	for _, mutation in ipairs(module.Mutations or {}) do
		local name = tostring(mutation.Name)
		local entry = {
			name = name,
			display = displayMutation(name),
			weight = tonumber(mutation.Weight) or 0,
			multiplier = tonumber(mutation.PriceMultiplier) or 1,
			eventOnly = mutation.EventOnly == true,
			color = gradientColor(Scanner.mutationGradients, name, FALLBACK_MUTATION_COLOR),
		}
		Data.mutations[#Data.mutations + 1] = entry
		Data.mutationByName[name] = entry
	end

	table.sort(Data.mutations, function(a, b)
		local aIndex = orderIndex[a.name]
		local bIndex = orderIndex[b.name]
		if aIndex and bIndex then
			return aIndex < bIndex
		elseif aIndex then
			return true
		elseif bIndex then
			return false
		end
		if a.weight ~= b.weight then
			return a.weight < b.weight
		end
		return a.name < b.name
	end)

	Data.ready = #Data.packs > 0 and #Data.mutations > 0
	return Data.ready
end

function Data.getPack(packId)
	return Data.packById[packId]
end

function Data.getMutation(name)
	return Data.mutationByName[name]
end

-- 6. NET — клик по кнопке ролла и покупка пака
--============================================================

local Engine
local UI
local destroy

local Net = {
	remote = nil,
	onEvent = nil,
	buySent = {},
	clickMode = "none",
}

local random = Random.new()

local function markBuySent(itemId)
	Net.buySent[itemId] = os.clock()
	-- Чистим старые записи, чтобы таблица не росла бесконечно.
	local now = os.clock()
	for key, at in pairs(Net.buySent) do
		if now - at > 60 then
			Net.buySent[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- Клик по кнопке спавна: сначала fireclickdetector, затем мышь.
function Net.click()
	local detector = Scanner.clickDetector
	if not detector then
		return false, "no-detector"
	end

	if type(fireclickdetector) == "function" then
		local ok = pcall(fireclickdetector, detector)
		if ok then
			Net.clickMode = "clickdetector"
			return true
		end
	end

	-- Fallback: наводим мышь на кнопку и кликаем.
	if type(mousemoveabs) == "function" and type(mouse1click) == "function" then
		local part = Scanner.buttonPart
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if part and camera then
			local okPoint, screenPoint = pcall(function()
				return camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			end)
			if okPoint and screenPoint then
				pcall(mousemoveabs, screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y)
				pcall(mouse1click)
				Net.clickMode = "mouse"
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	Net.clickMode = "none"
	return false, "no-input"
end

-- Покупка пака, который уже доехал до точки B. Один раз на ItemId.
function Net.tryBuy(itemId)
	if itemId == nil or Net.buySent[itemId] then
		return false
	end
	local remote = Net.remote
	if not remote then
		return false
	end
	markBuySent(itemId)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		remote:FireServer("TryBuy", { ItemId = itemId })
	end)
	if not ok then
		warnLog("WARN TryBuy failed for item " .. tostring(itemId))
	end
	return ok
end

function Net.init()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if not remotes then
		remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
	end
	Net.remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("ConveyorRE")
	if not Net.remote then
		warnLog("WARN ConveyorRE not found — remote logic disabled")
		return false
	end

	track(Net.remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
		if Net.onEvent then
			local ok, err = pcall(Net.onEvent, action, data)
			if not ok then
				warnLog("WARN event handler error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end))

	log("remote ready: " .. Net.remote:GetFullName())
	return true
end

--============================================================
-- 7. ENGINE — цикл авторолла и автопокупки
--============================================================

Engine = {
	running = false,
	status = "STOPPED",
	readyAt = 0,
	lastClickAt = 0,
	lastItem = nil,
	stats = {
		rolls = 0,
		seen = 0,
		bought = 0,
		skipped = 0,
		failed = 0,
	},
	seq = {
		ack = 0,
		spawn = 0,
		buy = 0,
		resolve = 0,
	},
	pending = {}, -- itemId → { packId, mutation, price, rarity, at }
	flags = {},   -- itemId → { packAtB, buyPending, resolved }
}

local function cleanupMaps()
	local now = os.clock()
	for itemId, info in pairs(Engine.pending) do
		if now - (info.at or now) > 60 then
			Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
			Engine.flags[itemId] = nil
		end
	end
	for itemId, flag in pairs(Engine.flags) do
		if flag.resolved and now - (flag.at or now) > 60 then
			Engine.flags[itemId] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function packLabel(info)
	if not info then
		return "pack", "mutation"
	end
	local pack = Data.getPack(info.packId)
	local mutation = Data.getMutation(info.mutation)
	local packName = pack and pack.id or tostring(info.packId)
	local mutationName = mutation and mutation.display or tostring(info.mutation)
	return packName, mutationName
end

local function resolveItem(itemId, kind, reason)
	local flag = Engine.flags[itemId]
	if not flag or flag.resolved then
		return
	end
	flag.resolved = true
	flag.at = os.clock()
	Engine.seq.resolve = Engine.seq.resolve + 1

	local info = Engine.pending[itemId]
	local packName, mutationName = packLabel(info)

	if kind == "bought" then
		Engine.stats.bought = Engine.stats.bought + 1
		if UI then
			UI.notify("good", "Bought", packName .. " · " .. mutationName)
		end
	elseif kind == "failed" then
		Engine.stats.failed = Engine.stats.failed + 1
		if reason == "NotEnoughMoney" then
			local stopOnNoMoney = Store.get().options.stopOnNoMoney ~= false
			if UI then
				UI.notify("danger", "Not enough money", stopOnNoMoney and "Autoroll stopped" or "Autoroll keeps rolling")
			end
			if stopOnNoMoney then
				warnLog("WARN not enough money — stopping")
				Engine.stop("NO MONEY")
			end
		elseif UI then
			UI.notify("danger", "Buy failed", tostring(reason or "unknown"))
		end
	end

	Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
	if UI then
		UI.updateStats()
	end
end

-- Обработчик всех событий ConveyorRE.
function Engine.handleEvent(action, data)
	if action == "ButtonClicked" then
		Engine.seq.ack = Engine.seq.ack + 1
		if type(data) == "table" and data.PlotNumber ~= nil and Scanner.plotNumber ~= nil then
			if tostring(data.PlotNumber) ~= tostring(Scanner.plotNumber) then
				Engine.seq.ack = Engine.seq.ack - 1
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if action == "PurchaseSound" then
		return
	end

	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	-- События чужого плота игнорируем.
	if data.PlotNumber ~= nil and Scanner.plotNumber ~= nil then
		if tostring(data.PlotNumber) ~= tostring(Scanner.plotNumber) then
			return
		end
	end

	local itemId = data.ItemId
	if itemId == nil then
		return
	end

	if action == "SpawnAndMoveToB" then
		cleanupMaps()
		Engine.pending[itemId] = {
			itemId = itemId,
			packId = tostring(data.PackId or data.PackAssetName or "Unknown"),
			mutation = tostring(data.Mutation or "Normal"),
			price = tonumber(data.Price) or 0,
			rarity = tostring(data.Rarity or ""),
			at = os.clock(),
		}
		Engine.flags[itemId] = { at = os.clock() }
		Engine.lastItem = itemId
		Engine.seq.spawn = Engine.seq.spawn + 1
		Engine.stats.seen = Engine.stats.seen + 1
		if UI then
			UI.updateStats()
		end
	elseif action == "PackAtB" then
		local info = Engine.pending[itemId]
		if not info then
			return
		end
		local flag = Engine.flags[itemId]
		if not flag then
			flag = { at = os.clock() }
			Engine.flags[itemId] = flag
		end
		flag.packAtB = true

		local allowed = Store.isAllowed(info.packId, info.mutation)
		if not allowed then
			if UI then
				UI.updateLastSeen(info)
			end
			return
		end

		flag.buyPending = true
		Engine.seq.buy = Engine.seq.buy + 1
		local delay = 0.06 + random:NextNumber(0, 0.14)
		task.delay(delay, function()
			if not Engine.running then
				if not flag.resolved then
					flag.resolved = true
					Engine.seq.resolve = Engine.seq.resolve + 1
				end
				return
			end
			if not flag.resolved then
				Net.tryBuy(itemId)
			end
		end)
	elseif action == "BoughtAndRemove" then
		resolveItem(itemId, "bought")
	elseif action == "BuyFailed" then
		resolveItem(itemId, "failed", data.Reason)
	elseif action == "MoveToCAndDestroy" then
		local flag = Engine.flags[itemId]
		local info = Engine.pending[itemId]
		if info and (not flag or not flag.resolved) then
			Engine.stats.skipped = Engine.stats.skipped + 1
			if UI then
				UI.updateStats()
			end
		end
		if flag and not flag.resolved then
			flag.resolved = true
			flag.at = os.clock()
			Engine.seq.resolve = Engine.seq.resolve + 1
		end
		Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
	elseif action == "RecoverRollback" or action == "DestroyOrphanedPack" then
		Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
		Engine.flags[itemId] = nil
	end
end

function Engine.setStatus(status)
	Engine.status = status
	if UI then
		UI.setStatus(status)
	end
end

-- Один шаг цикла: клик → ожидание пака → ожидание покупки.
function Engine.step()
	local cfg = Store.get()
	local interval = math.max(CONFIG.minTimingMs, tonumber(cfg.timingMs) or CONFIG.timingMs) / 1000
	local jitter = (tonumber(cfg.jitterMs) or CONFIG.jitterMs) / 1000

	if not Scanner.ensure() then
		if Engine.status ~= "NOT READY" then
			Engine.setStatus("NOT READY")
		end
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end

	if Engine.status == "NOT READY" then
		Engine.setStatus("RUNNING")
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if now < Engine.readyAt then
		task.wait(math.min(0.05, Engine.readyAt - now))
		return
	end

	local canPress = Scanner.getCanPress()
	if canPress == false then
		task.wait(0.08)
		return
	end

	local spawnBefore = Engine.seq.spawn
	local clickAt = os.clock()
	local clicked, reason = Net.click()
	if not clicked then
		warnLog("WARN roll click failed: " .. tostring(reason))
		Engine.setStatus("NOT READY")
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end

	Engine.stats.rolls = Engine.stats.rolls + 1
	Engine.lastClickAt = clickAt
	Engine.readyAt = clickAt + interval + random:NextNumber(0, jitter)
	if UI then
		UI.updateStats()
	end

	-- Ждём подтверждение спавна от сервера.
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while Engine.running and Engine.seq.spawn == spawnBefore and os.clock() - t0 < 2 do
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	if Engine.seq.spawn == spawnBefore then
		warnLog("WARN no spawn confirmation within 2s")
		if Engine.running then
			Engine.setStatus("NOT READY")
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
		return
	end

	local itemId = Engine.lastItem
	local flag = itemId and Engine.flags[itemId]
	if flag then
		-- Ждём, пока пак доедет до точки B.
		local t1 = os.clock()
		while Engine.running and not flag.packAtB and not flag.resolved and os.clock() - t1 < 2 do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		-- Если покупка запрошена — ждём её результат.
		if flag.buyPending and not flag.resolved then
			local t2 = os.clock()
			while Engine.running and not flag.resolved and os.clock() - t2 < 2 do
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
		end
	end

	if os.clock() > Engine.readyAt then
		Engine.readyAt = os.clock()
	end
end

function Engine.runLoop()
	while Engine.running do
		local ok, err = pcall(Engine.step)
		if not ok then
			warnLog("WARN engine error: " .. tostring(err))
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end
end

function Engine.start()
	if Engine.running then
		return
	end
	if not Data.ready then
		warnLog("WARN pack data not ready, autoroll may not buy anything")
	end
	Scanner.refresh()
	Engine.running = true
	Engine.readyAt = os.clock()
	Engine.setStatus("RUNNING")
	task.spawn(Engine.runLoop)
	log("autoroll started")
	if UI then
		UI.onEngineState()
	end
end

function Engine.stop(reason)
	local wasRunning = Engine.running
	Engine.running = false
	Engine.setStatus(reason or "STOPPED")
	if wasRunning then
		log("autoroll stopped" .. (reason and (": " .. reason) or ""))
	end
	if UI then
		UI.onEngineState()
	end
end

function Engine.toggle()
	if Engine.running then
		Engine.stop("STOPPED")
	else
		Engine.start()
	end
end

function Engine.resetStats()
	for key in pairs(Engine.stats) do
		Engine.stats[key] = 0
	end
	if UI then
		UI.updateStats()
	end
end

function Engine.init()
	Engine.running = false
	Engine.setStatus("STOPPED")
	Net.onEvent = Engine.handleEvent

	-- Слежение за сменой плота (респавн / телепорт).
	local plotValue = player:FindFirstChild("PlotNumber")
	if plotValue and plotValue:IsA("ValueBase") then
		track(plotValue.Changed:Connect(function()
			Scanner.refresh()
			if UI then
				UI.refreshAll()
			end
		end))
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8.1 Словари мутаций (display ↔ raw)
------------------------------------------------------------------

local function rebuildMutationMaps()
	UI.mutLabels = {}
	UI.mutToRaw = {}
	UI.rawToLabel = {}

	for _, mutation in ipairs(Data.mutations) do
		local label = mutation.display
		if UI.mutToRaw[label] then
			-- редкий случай: одинаковые display-имена — показываем сырое имя
			label = mutation.name
		end
		UI.mutLabels[#UI.mutLabels + 1] = label
		UI.mutToRaw[label] = mutation.name
		UI.rawToLabel[mutation.name] = label
	end
end

local function packNames()
	local names = {}
	for _, pack in ipairs(Data.packs) do
		names[#names + 1] = pack.id
	end
	return names
end

-- NextUI не любит пустые списки значений — подставляем заглушку.
local function safeValues(list, placeholder)
	if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then
		return { placeholder }
	end
	return list
end

local function allowedLabels(packId)
	local labels = {}
	local entry = Store.readPack(packId)
	if not entry then
		return labels
	end
	for rawName, allowed in pairs(entry.mutations) do
		if allowed == true then
			labels[#labels + 1] = UI.rawToLabel[rawName] or rawName
		end
	end
	table.sort(labels)
	return labels
end

local function writeMutations(packId, labels)
	local entry = Store.packEntry(packId)
	entry.mutations = {}
	for _, label in ipairs(labels or {}) do
		local rawName = UI.mutToRaw[label] or label
		if Data.mutationByName[rawName] then
			entry.mutations[rawName] = true
		end
	end
	Store.save()
end

local function packEntryEnabled(packId)
	local entry = Store.readPack(packId)
	return entry ~= nil and entry.enabled == true
end

local function setPackEnabled(packId, enabled)
	local entry = Store.packEntry(packId)
	entry.enabled = enabled == true
	Store.save()
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8.2 Тексты для карточек
------------------------------------------------------------------

local function overviewText()
	if not Data.ready then
		return "Pack data is unavailable. The ConveyorPacks module was not found — "
			.. "open the Packs tab again after you joined a plot, or press \"Reload pack data\"."
	end
	local lines = {}
	for _, pack in ipairs(Data.packs) do
		local entry = Store.readPack(pack.id)
		local enabled = entry ~= nil and entry.enabled == true
		local labels = allowedLabels(pack.id)
		local mutationText = "no mutations"
		if #labels > 0 then
			mutationText = table.concat(labels, ", ")
		end
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"%s %s — %s",
			enabled and "[ON] " or "[off]",
			pack.id,
			mutationText
		)
	end
	if #lines == 0 then
		lines[1] = "No packs found."
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function statsText()
	local s = Engine.stats
	return string.format(
		"Rolls %d   ·   Seen %d   ·   Bought %d\nSkipped %d   ·   Failed %d",
		s.rolls,
		s.seen,
		s.bought,
		s.skipped,
		s.failed
	)
end

local function plotText()
	local parts = {}
	if Scanner.plotNumber ~= nil then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "Plot " .. tostring(Scanner.plotNumber)
	else
		parts[#parts + 1] = "Plot unknown"
	end
	if Scanner.clickDetector then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "spawn button found"
	else
		parts[#parts + 1] = "spawn button missing"
	end
	if Net.clickMode == "clickdetector" then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "click: clickdetector"
	elseif Net.clickMode == "mouse" then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "click: mouse"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "  ·  ")
end

local function storageText()
	local mode = Store.isFileMode() and ("file: " .. CONFIG.storageFolder .. "/" .. CONFIG.storageFile)
		or "PlayerGui attributes (not saved between rejoins)"
	return string.format(
		"%s\nPacks %d   ·   Mutations %d   ·   Interval %d ms",
		mode,
		#Data.packs,
		#Data.mutations,
		Store.get().timingMs
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8.3 Публичные методы UI (их зовёт движок)
------------------------------------------------------------------

function UI.notify(kind, title, content)
	local nextui = UI.nextui
	if not nextui then
		log(title .. (content and (" — " .. content) or ""))
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		if kind == "good" then
			nextui:Success(title, content)
		elseif kind == "danger" then
			nextui:Error(title, content)
		elseif kind == "warn" then
			nextui:Warning(title, content)
		else
			nextui:Info(title, content)
		end
	end)
end

-- Совместимость со старым кодом движка.
function UI.toast(text, kind)
	UI.notify(kind or "info", "Conveyor Auto", text)
end

function UI.updateStats()
	if not UI.statsLabel then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		UI.statsLabel:Set("Counters", statsText())
	end)
end

function UI.setStatus(status)
	UI.status = status
	if UI.statusLabel then
		local text = STATUS_TEXT[status] or tostring(status)
		pcall(function()
			UI.statusLabel:Set("State", text .. "\n" .. plotText())
		end)
	end
	if UI.storageLabel then
		pcall(function()
			UI.storageLabel:Set("Storage", storageText())
		end)
	end
end

-- Держит переключатель Autoroll в синхроне с реальным состоянием движка.
function UI.onEngineState()
	if not UI.autorollToggle or UI._syncing then
		return
	end
	local want = Engine.running == true
	local ok, current = pcall(function()
		return UI.autorollToggle:Get()
	end)
	if not ok or current == want then
		return
	end
	UI._syncing = true
	pcall(function()
		UI.autorollToggle:Set(want)
	end)
	UI._syncing = false
end

function UI.updateLastSeen(info)
	if not UI.lastLabel then
		return
	end
	local packName, mutationName = packLabel(info)
	local price = info and info.price or 0
	pcall(function()
		UI.lastLabel:Set("Last seen", string.format("%s  ·  %s  ·  %s", packName, mutationName, formatPrice(price)))
	end)
end

function UI.refreshOverview()
	if not UI.overviewLabel then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		UI.overviewLabel:Set("All packs", overviewText())
	end)
end

-- Ставит выбранный пак в дропдаун + его мутации в мультиселект.
function UI.selectPack(packId, skipSync)
	if not Data.packById[packId] then
		for _, pack in ipairs(Data.packs) do
			packId = pack.id
			break
		end
	end
	UI.selectedPack = packId
	if skipSync then
		return
	end
	UI._silent = true
	if UI.packDropdown then
		pcall(function()
			UI.packDropdown:Set(packId)
		end)
	end
	if UI.mutSelect then
		pcall(function()
			UI.mutSelect:Set(allowedLabels(packId))
		end)
	end
	UI._silent = false
end

-- Полное обновление: значения из Store + тексты.
function UI.refreshAll()
	if not UI.window then
		return
	end
	local cfg = Store.get()
	UI._silent = true

	if UI.intervalSlider then
		pcall(function()
			UI.intervalSlider:Set(cfg.timingMs)
		end)
	end
	if UI.jitterSlider then
		pcall(function()
			UI.jitterSlider:Set(cfg.jitterMs)
		end)
	end
	if UI.stopToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.stopToggle:Set(cfg.options.stopOnNoMoney == true)
		end)
	end
	if UI.autoToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.autoToggle:Set(cfg.options.autoStart == true)
		end)
	end
	if UI.bindListToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.bindListToggle:Set(cfg.options.showBindList == true)
		end)
	end
	if UI.menuKeyBind then
		pcall(function()
			UI.menuKeyBind:Set(keyCodeOf(cfg.keybinds.toggleUI, Enum.KeyCode.RightShift))
		end)
	end
	if UI.autorollToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.autorollToggle:Set(Engine.running == true)
		end)
	end
	UI._silent = false

	if UI.packDropdown then
		pcall(function()
			UI.packDropdown:Refresh(safeValues(packNames(), "(packs unavailable)"))
		end)
	end
	if UI.bulkSelect then
		pcall(function()
			UI.bulkSelect:Refresh(safeValues(UI.mutLabels, "(no mutations)"))
		end)
	end
	UI.selectPack(UI.selectedPack)
	UI.refreshOverview()
	UI.updateStats()
	UI.updateStatusOnly()
	UI.setStatus(Engine.status)
end

function UI.updateStatusOnly()
	if not UI.statusLabel then
		return
	end
	local text = STATUS_TEXT[UI.status] or tostring(UI.status)
	pcall(function()
		UI.statusLabel:Set("State", text .. "\n" .. plotText())
	end)
end

-- После "Reset defaults" подтягиваем значения заново.
function UI.afterReset()
	UI.refreshAll()
	UI.notify("warn", "Settings reset", "Defaults restored")
end

--============================================================
-- 9. BOOT — сборка и запуск
--============================================================

function destroy()
	if Engine and Engine.stop then
		Engine.stop("STOPPED")
	end
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	connections = {}
	if UI and UI.nextui then
		pcall(function()
			UI.nextui:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	UI.window = nil
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
	if env and env.ConveyorAuto and env.ConveyorAuto.version == VERSION then
		env.ConveyorAuto = nil
	end
	log("destroyed")
end

local function boot()
	log("v" .. VERSION .. " starting… (NextUI)")

	-- Корректно снимаем предыдущий запуск, если он был.
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
	if env and env.ConveyorAuto and type(env.ConveyorAuto.destroy) == "function" then
		pcall(env.ConveyorAuto.destroy)
	end

	Store.init()
	Scanner.refresh()
	Data.build()
	Engine.init()
	local netOk = Net.init()
	local uiOk = UI.build()

	if uiOk then
		UI.refreshAll()
	end

	log(string.format(
		"loaded · packs=%d · mutations=%d · timing=%dms · storage=%s",
		#Data.packs,
		#Data.mutations,
		Store.get().timingMs,
		Store.isFileMode() and "file" or "attributes"
	))

	if not uiOk then
		warnLog("WARN NextUI failed to load — the script keeps running without a window")
	end
	if not netOk then
		warnLog("WARN ConveyorRE unavailable — auto-buy disabled")
	end
	if not Data.ready then
		warnLog("WARN pack data unavailable — pack list disabled")
	end

	if env then
		env.ConveyorAuto = {
			version = VERSION,
			destroy = destroy,
			engine = Engine,
			data = Data,
			store = Store,
			ui = UI,
			net = Net,
			scanner = Scanner,
		}
	end

	if Store.get().options.autoStart then
		task.delay(1, function()
			if not Engine.running then
				Engine.start()
			end
		end)
	end
end

boot()

-- Lunyx / DRIVE: Highway. Built from the 2026-11-17 client dump.
-- No external UI dependencies. RightControl hides/shows the panel.
assert(game.PlaceId == 120511086614436, "This script is for DRIVE: Highway.")
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if type(env.LunyxDriveStop) == "function" then env.LunyxDriveStop() end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local guiParent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local modules = RS:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Game")
local racer = modules:WaitForChild("Racer")
local highway = racer:WaitForChild("Highway")
local shared = RS:WaitForChild("Shared")
local State = require(shared:WaitForChild("VehicleState"))
local Rules = require(shared:WaitForChild("ScoreRules"))
local ServerRules = require(shared:WaitForChild("ServerRules"))
local Config = require(shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Traffic = require(shared:WaitForChild("Traffic"))
local Score = require(modules:WaitForChild("Score"):WaitForChild("ScoreClient"))
local Controls = require(racer:WaitForChild("Input"):WaitForChild("Controls"))
local Road = require(highway:WaitForChild("Road"))
local RoadConfig = require(highway:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Front = require(modules:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("FrontEndUI"))
local Daily = require(modules:WaitForChild("Store"):WaitForChild("DailyLoginClient"))
local heat = Score.streetHeat
assert(type(heat) == "table" and type(heat.add) == "function", "Score API changed.")
assert(type(Controls.placeAt) == "function" and type(Road.nearestS) == "function",
    "Driving API changed.")

local alive, farming, boost, autoDaily = true, false, true, true
local targetMph = 90
local links, buttons = {}, {}
local previousPilot, pilot
local laneSide, lane, travelDir, lastS, targetX
local laneAt, recoverAt, spawnAt = 0, 0, -20
local stuck, tickAt, uiAt, dailyAt = 0, 0, 0, -30
local baseline = tonumber(heat.profile.credits) or 0
local farmBaseline, farmStarted, lastConfirmedAt = baseline, os.clock(), os.clock()
local observedCredits = baseline
local note = "Ready. Enable Auto farm."
local records, recordCount = {}, 0

local function connect(signal, fn)
    local connection = signal:Connect(fn)
    links[#links + 1] = connection
    return connection
end
local function make(class, properties, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
    object.Parent = parent
    return object
end
local oldGui = guiParent:FindFirstChild("LunyxDrive")
if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end
local gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name = "LunyxDrive", ResetOnSpawn = false,
    DisplayOrder = 1000, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling}, guiParent)
local panel = make("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 424),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0.5, -212), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 25, 33),
    BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true}, gui)
make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)}, panel)
local title = make("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 42),
    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0), Text = "LUNYX / HIGHWAY",
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 232, 245), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true}, panel)
local status = make("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 45),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(282, 106), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(161, 188, 209), Font = Enum.Font.Code,
    TextSize = 13, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextWrapped = true, Text = note}, panel)
local function button(text, row, action)
    local b = make("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 157 + row * 36),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(282, 30), Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(233, 238, 245),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(39, 46, 60), BorderSizePixel = 0}, panel)
    make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)}, b)
    connect(b.Activated, function()
        local ok, err = pcall(action)
        if not ok then note = tostring(err); warn("[Lunyx] " .. note) end
    end)
    buttons[#buttons + 1] = b
    return b
end
local function releasePilot()
    if Controls.autopilot == pilot then Controls.autopilot = previousPilot end
    previousPilot = nil
end
local function toggleFarm(value)
    farming = value
    if farming then
        previousPilot = Controls.autopilot
        laneSide, lane, lastS, targetX = nil, nil, nil, nil
        stuck, spawnAt = 0, -20
        farmBaseline = tonumber(heat.profile.credits) or 0
        farmStarted, lastConfirmedAt = os.clock(), os.clock()
        note = "Starting / selecting an owned car..."
    else
        releasePilot()
        note = "Stopped. Manual driving restored."
    end
end
local function recover()
    local root = State.chassis
    if not State.active or not root or not root.Parent then return false end
    local s, x = Road.nearestS(root.Position, lastS or State.roadDist)
    local side = laneSide or (x >= 0 and 1 or -1)
    local cf = Road.surfaceAt(s + (travelDir or 1) * 25, Road.laneOffset(side, lane or 2))
    if (travelDir or 1) < 0 then cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) end
    local accepted = Controls.placeAt(cf)
    if accepted then recoverAt, stuck = os.clock(), 0 end
    return accepted
end

-- Read the game's deterministic traffic simulation for lane selection.
local function updateTraffic(s)
    local now = Config.serverTime()
    local count = Traffic.carsInRange(s - 350, s + 350, now, records)
    recordCount = type(count) == "number" and count or 0
end
local function clearance(s, x)
    local front, rear = 350, 350
    for i = 1, recordCount do
        local car = records[i]
        if car and type(car.lateral) == "number" and type(car.dist) == "number"
            and math.abs(car.lateral - x) < RoadConfig.LANE_WIDTH * 0.65 then
            local distance = Road.deltaS(s, car.dist) * travelDir
            if distance >= 0 then front = math.min(front, distance)
            else rear = math.min(rear, -distance) end
        end
    end
    return front, rear
end

pilot = function(dt)
    if not farming then return nil end
    local root = State.chassis
    if not State.active or State.inputBlocked or not root or not root.Parent or root.Anchored then
        return 0, 0, 0
    end
    local s, x = Road.nearestS(root.Position, lastS or State.roadDist)
    lastS = s
    if not laneSide then
        laneSide = x >= 0 and 1 or -1
        travelDir = root.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(Road.frameAt(s).LookVector) >= 0 and 1 or -1
        lane = 1
        for i = 2, RoadConfig.LANES_PER_SIDE do
            if math.abs(Road.laneOffset(laneSide, i) - x)
                < math.abs(Road.laneOffset(laneSide, lane) - x) then lane = i end
        end
        targetX = Road.laneOffset(laneSide, lane)
    end
    local laneX = Road.laneOffset(laneSide, lane)
    local front = clearance(s, laneX)
    if front < 200 and os.clock() - laneAt > 1.5 then
        local best, bestClear = lane, front
        for _, candidate in ipairs({lane - 1, lane + 1}) do
            if candidate >= 1 and candidate <= RoadConfig.LANES_PER_SIDE then
                local ahead, behind = clearance(s, Road.laneOffset(laneSide, candidate))
                if behind > 45 and ahead > bestClear + 35 then
                    best, bestClear = candidate, ahead
                end
            end
        end
        if best ~= lane then lane, laneAt = best, os.clock() end
    end
    laneX = Road.laneOffset(laneSide, lane)
    targetX = targetX + math.clamp(laneX - targetX, -dt * 12, dt * 12)
    local speed = math.abs(tonumber(State.speedMph) or 0)
    local desired = targetMph
    local gap = clearance(s, targetX)
    if gap < 140 then desired = math.min(desired, math.max(0, (gap - 24) * 0.65)) end
    if State.inStartArea then desired = math.min(desired, 45) end
    local ahead = math.clamp(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * 0.75, 35, 160)
    local point = Road.pointAt(s + travelDir * ahead, targetX)
    local localPoint = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
    local steer = math.clamp(math.atan2(localPoint.X, -localPoint.Z) / 0.45, -1, 1)
    local error = desired - speed
    return math.clamp(0.18 + error * 0.045, 0, 1),
        math.clamp((-error - 3) * 0.06, 0, 1), steer
end

local function ensureCar()
    if os.clock() - spawnAt < 12 then return end
    spawnAt = os.clock()
    local api = Front._test
    if type(api) ~= "table" or type(api.info) ~= "function" then
        note = "Select a car and press Drive once."
        return
    end
    local info = api.info()
    if info.busy then return end
    local owned = {}
    for token in tostring(info.cars or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        if not token:find("$", 1, true) then owned[#owned + 1] = token:gsub("%*", "") end
    end
    local pick
    for _, id in ipairs(owned) do
        if not pick or id == info.pick or id == info.last then pick = id end
    end
    if info.mode == "hub" or info.mode == "picker" then
        if pick then Front.driveCar(pick)
        elseif info.mode == "hub" then api.play()
        else note = "Choose your free starter car once." end
    elseif info.mode == "driving" or info.mode == "legacy" then
        api.respawn()
    else
        note = "Waiting for the game menu: " .. tostring(info.mode)
    end
end

local farmButton = button("Auto farm: OFF", 0, function() toggleFarm(not farming) end)
local boostButton = button("Score boost: ON", 1, function() boost = not boost end)
local dailyButton = button("Daily reward: AUTO", 2, function() autoDaily = not autoDaily end)
local speedButton = button("Cruise speed: 90 mph", 3, function()
    targetMph = targetMph == 90 and 120 or targetMph == 120 and 150 or 90
end)

button("Recover to road", 5, function()

end)

    Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 5), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 232, 245), TextSize = 20}, panel)

local function stop()
    if not alive then return end
    toggleFarm(false)
    alive = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(links) do connection:Disconnect() end
    gui:Destroy()
end
env.LunyxDriveStop = stop

    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then panel.Visible = not panel.Visible end
    if farming and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space) then

end)
local dragAt, panelAt
connect(title.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragAt, panelAt = input.Position, panel.Position
    end
end)
connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)

connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
    if dragAt and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Position - dragAt
        panel.Position = panelAt + UDim2.fromOffset(delta.X, delta.Y)
    end
end)

local function step(dt)
    if not alive then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if farming then
        Controls.autopilot = pilot
        if not State.active then
            ensureCar()
        elseif State.chassis and State.chassis.Parent then
            local speed = math.abs(tonumber(State.speedMph) or 0)
            stuck = speed < 3 and not State.inputBlocked and stuck + dt or 0
            if (stuck > 12 or State.overturned) and now - recoverAt > 10 then recover() end
            note = State.inputBlocked and "Waiting for menu to close..." or "Auto driving"
        end
    end
    tickAt = tickAt + dt
    if tickAt >= 0.2 then
        local elapsed = math.min(tickAt, 0.25)
        tickAt = 0
        if farming and State.active and State.chassis and not State.inputBlocked then
            local ok, err = pcall(updateTraffic, lastS or State.roadDist or 0)
            if not ok then recordCount = 0; warn("[Lunyx traffic] " .. tostring(err)) end
            -- This exposed game function updates the real streak. The game's
            -- own sendTick sends score_earn; no custom remote packet is forged.
            -- Keep force=false: no devHeat and no bypass of movement/site checks.
            if boost and not State.inStartArea and ServerRules.earnRate() > 0
                and math.abs(tonumber(State.speedMph) or 0) >= Rules.STREAK_SLOW_MPH then
                local rawPerSecond = math.min(1500, (Rules.MAX_RAW_PER_SEC or 6000) * 0.25)
                heat.add(rawPerSecond * elapsed, nil, true, false, false)
            end
        end
    end
    if autoDaily and now - dailyAt > 30 then
        dailyAt = now
        if player:GetAttribute("DailyClaimable") == true then Daily.claimToday() end
    end
    uiAt = uiAt + dt
    if uiAt >= 0.5 then
        uiAt = 0
        local confirmed = tonumber(heat.profile.credits) or 0
        if confirmed ~= observedCredits then observedCredits, lastConfirmedAt = confirmed, now end
        local rate = farming and (confirmed - farmBaseline) * 60 / math.max(now - farmStarted, 1) or 0
        local pending = math.max(0, (heat.balance()) - confirmed)
        local warning = farming and boost and pending > 100 and now - lastConfirmedAt > 20
        status.Text = string.format("Server cash: $%d  (+%d)\nPending: $%d | $%d/min\nSpeed: %d mph | Traffic: %d%%\n%s",
            confirmed, confirmed - baseline, pending, math.floor(rate),
            math.abs(tonumber(State.speedMph) or 0), math.round(ServerRules.traffic() * 100),
            warning and "No server payment yet; boost unconfirmed." or note)
        farmButton.Text = "Auto farm: " .. (farming and "ON" or "OFF")
        farmButton.BackgroundColor3 = farming and Color3.fromRGB(28, 94, 80) or Color3.fromRGB(39, 46, 60)
        boostButton.Text = "Score boost: " .. (boost and "ON" or "OFF")
        dailyButton.Text = "Daily reward: " .. (autoDaily and "AUTO" or "OFF")
        speedButton.Text = "Cruise speed: " .. targetMph .. " mph"
    end
end
connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
    local ok, err = pcall(step, dt)
    if not ok then
        if farming then toggleFarm(false) end
        note = "Error: " .. tostring(err)
        status.Text = note
        warn("[Lunyx] " .. note)
    end
end)

    end
    
    if data and data.choices and data.choices[1] and data.choices[1].message and data.choices[1].message.content then
        return data.choices[1].message.content
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "ChatGPT Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse ChatGPT response"
end


local function CallAI(userMessage)
    if currentAI == "Gemini" then
        return CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Claude" then
        return CallClaudeAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ClaudeApi)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Llama" then
        return CallGroqLlamaAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Gpt Oss" then
        return CallGroqGptOssAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Gpt-4" then
        return CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ChatGptApi)
    else

    end
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

	leftBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		current = math.max(min, current - step)
		current = math.floor(current * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		value.Text = tostring(current)
		callback(current)
	end)
	
	rightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		current = math.min(max, current + step)
		current = math.floor(current * 100 + 0.5) / 100

	end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

local function ProximityPromptCountdown()
   while _G.AutoProximityPrompt do
    wait(_G.ProximityPromptCountdown)
        for i, v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace"):GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then 
                fireproximityprompt(v, 1, true)
            end 
        end  -- Espera o tempo definido em _G.ProximityPromptCountdown antes de repetir
    end
end

Section3:Button({
   Text = "Rainbow (Client)",
   Callback = function()
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end
})


Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k

    return formatted

    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then

            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {

                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then

            if safePart then

                else

                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

Queue.__index = Queue
function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

funcs.crypt.hex.decode = function(hex)
    hex = tostring(hex)
    local text = ""
    for i = 1, #hex, 2 do
        local byte_str = string.sub(hex, i, i+1)
        local byte = tonumber(byte_str, 16)
        text = text .. string.char(byte)
    end
    return text
end

funcs.crypt.generatekey = function(optionalSize)
 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end
 return funcs.base64.encode(key)
end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

    local found = false

     if v == fnc then return true end
    end
    for i = 1, math.huge do
        local s, env = pcall(getfenv, i)
        if not s or found then break end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, v in pairs(env) do
                if v == fnc then
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if found then break end
    end

end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end
